title: Director, Engineering, Platform Operations & Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Director, Engineering, Platform Operations & Productivity, you'll own three functions that all require hands-on technical depth, not just people management.</p> <p>Platform Staff is a small, senior, AI-native team that moves to wherever the organization needs the most leverage, from standing up early scaffolding for an initiative, to taking on a high-impact customer request that doesn't fit any existing team's charter, to stepping directly into a production crisis until it's resolved.</p> <p>This role is for a technical engineering director who has personally built distributed systems, not only managed people who did. You'll use clear metrics, strong operating rhythms, and direct technical judgment so these teams deliver predictable outcomes without relying on one-person heroics.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own outcomes for Git & Gitaly Operations, including hiring and developing the Manager, Git & Gitaly Operations, and holding the function to its reliability bar across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.</li> <li>Own outcomes for Nonlinear Productivity, also known as Friction Elimination, including hiring and developing the Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, and holding the function to measurable metric movement rather than activity.</li> <li>Build and oversee Platform Staff directly as a small, senior team that uses AI-assisted tools as a standard part of its work.</li> <li>Assess, case by case, what Platform Staff picks up, such as a new team that needs bootstrapping, a customer request too specific for any existing team's charter, or a crisis that needs someone in the room immediately.</li> <li>Assess when Platform Staff should hand work off to a permanent team once it's stable.</li> <li>Set the technical bar across all three functions by personally reviewing distributed systems designs, friction-elimination fixes, and crisis management plans with equal depth.</li> <li>Build the operating rhythm and metrics that keep all three functions running predictably, so none of them relies on any one person working unsustainable hours.</li> <li>Represent all three functions to peer engineering stakeholders, and step in front of customers directly when Platform Staff is engaged mid-crisis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of GitLab's development workflows and platform capabilities so you can assess productivity friction, operational trade-offs, and team needs in context.</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing and shipping distributed systems personally, not only through teams you've managed.</li> <li>A track record running highly effective engineering operations, including production reliability and incident management, at meaningful scale.</li> <li>A track record driving measurable engineering productivity improvements across more than one team or organization.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development tools, and sound judgment about when they help a small team do work that would otherwise require a larger team.</li> <li>People management experience across multiple managers or functions at once.</li> <li>Ability to context-switch effectively across genuinely different problem types, including infrastructure operations, developer productivity, and ad hoc crisis response, sometimes in the same week.</li> <li>A track record making staffing decisions that keep a high-leverage team intentionally small, and building alignment around those decisions rather than growing the team by default.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We work across three connected platform and productivity functions. Through Git & Gitaly Operations, we are responsible for the production reliability of the infrastructure layer underneath GitLab's own version control system. Through Nonlinear Productivity, we drive measurable improvements to GitLab's software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows. Through Platform Staff, we provide focused senior engineering capacity for high-leverage work that needs direct ownership before it can be stabilized or handed off to a permanent team.</p> <p>Collectively, we help GitLab improve the reliability, productivity, and responsiveness of the platform that powers how our customers and GitLab team members build software.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. title: CRM & Lead Generation Manager (m/w/d)
description: Callwey ist der führende Verlag für stilvollen Lifestyle rund ums Haus. Wir publizieren jährlich 40 Novitäten in den Themen Interior, Design, Architektur, Wohnen, Gartengestaltung, Kochen Mode und Reisen und Lifestyle. Mit der Leidenschaft fürs Büchermachen begeistern wir als modernes Medienhaus und unabhängiges Familienunternehmen unsere Leser und entwickeln individuelle Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Für die Mitarbeit suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen CRM & Lead Generation Manager (m/w/d). Sie gestalten einen neuen Aufgabenbereich mit und bauen unser internationales Netzwerk potenzieller Kunden und Partner auf. Ihre Aufgaben – Sie identifizieren passende Unternehmen und recherchieren relevante Ansprechpartner und Kontaktdaten. – Sie bauen unsere Kontaktdatenbank systematisch auf, segmentieren Zielgruppen und sichern die Datenqualität. – Sie verwalten und pflegen Kontakte in HubSpot und unterstützen die Nutzung unserer Kundendaten in Shopify. – Sie nutzen KI-Tools für Recherche, Datenaufbereitung und zielgruppengerechte Ansprache. – Sie entwickeln personalisierte Erstansprachen und setzen Kampagnen um. – Sie qualifizieren gewonnene Kontakte und übergeben sie mit den relevanten Informationen an unser Salesteam zur individuellen Betreuung. – Sie analysieren die Ergebnisse und optimieren die Prozesse zur Recherche, Ansprache und Übergabe. Ihr Profil – Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System, idealerweise HubSpot. Kenntnisse in vergleichbaren Systemen sind ebenso willkommen. – Sie nutzen KI-Tools bereits praktisch, etwa für Recherche, Textentwicklung oder strukturierte Datenaufbereitung, und können die Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen und zuverlässig weiterverarbeiten. – Sie haben ein Gespür für relevante Geschäftskontakte und eine überzeugende, persönliche Ansprache. – Sie haben eine Affinität für hochwertige Medienprodukte und Premium-Marken. – Sie arbeiten selbstständig und strukturiert sowie schätzen die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing und Vertrieb. – Sie verfügen über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse für die Kommunikation mit internationalen Zielgruppen. Das bieten wir Ihnen – Selbstständiges und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten in einem kleinen, motivierten und kollegialen Team mit flachen Hierarchien – Viel Freiheit bei der Gestaltung der eigenen, abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben – Möglichkeit, schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen und eigene Ideen umzusetzen – Die Atmosphäre eines Familienunternehmens und traditionsreichen Verlagshauses – Regelmäßige Firmenevents – Charmante Büroräumlichkeiten in zentraler Lage im Glockenbachviertel – Sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung mit U-Bahnstation (U1, U2) in direkter Nähe Wir freuen uns über Ihre aussagekräftige Bewerbung! title: Founders Associate Intern (m/w/d) - Hybrid
description: PatientFirst Fertility baut eine der ambitioniertesten digital-first Gruppen moderner IVF-Kliniken im Privatzahlersegment - mit klarer Skalierungslogik und schlankem HQ. Die erste Klinik ist live und profitabel. Jetzt kommt die Phase, in der aus einer Klinik eine Gruppe wird. Du bist die rechte Hand des Gründers und arbeitest an dem, was gerade den größten Hebel hat. Heute eine Marktanalyse, morgen ein Klinikprozess, übermorgen ein Behördenantrag. Du brauchst keine feste Rollenbeschreibung, sondern den Ehrgeiz, jedes Problem zu lösen, das vor dir liegt - und den Instinkt, die Probleme zu erkennen, die noch keiner benannt hat. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer (Ex-Harvard, Ex-BCG) und dem C-Level, bekommst ab Tag eins echte Themen mit Verantwortung und siehst aus erster Reihe, wie eine skalierbare Plattform im Gesundheitswesen entsteht. Das Praktikum ist der Einstieg: Wer liefert, übernimmt danach eine feste Rolle. Aufgaben Automation & Analyse Reporting: monatliche Sheets und PDFs, Ad-hoc-Analysen bis in den Management- und Shareholder-Kreis Google-Ads-Operations sowie Funnel- und Tracking-QA innerhalb unserer bestehenden Architektur Digitalisierung und Automatisierung der laufenden Klinik: Patientenerfahrung verbessern, Prozesse verschlanken, Fehlerquoten senken, Skalierbarkeit sichern Operations & Daily Support Direkter Support des C-Levels Recruiting-Koordination: Sichtung, Terminierung, Feedback einsammeln HR-Administration der Klinik Bestellwesen nach Kategorienlogik, Wartungen, Lieferantenkoordination Schnittstelle zur Klinik: Bindeglied zwischen HQ und klinischem Team Tool- & System-Ownership: Mitverantwortung für unseren operativen Tool-Stack Aufbau- & Skalierungsprojekte Strategische Aufbau- und Wachstumsprojekte der Gruppe: von neuer klinischer Infrastruktur (inkl. Labor und OP) bis zur operativen Umsetzung Strategische Vorarbeit sowie Koordination externer Partner (Bauunternehmen, Architekten, Fachplaner) Unterstützung bei Anträgen und Genehmigungen für Behörden und Konzessionen, inkl. Fristen- und Dokumenten-Tracking Budget- und Timeline-Nachverfolgung über alle Workstreams hinweg Qualifikation Wir stellen nach Trajektorie ein, nicht nach Lebenslauf allein. Du hast dich in einem anspruchsvollem Umfeld bewiesen - Beratung, Startup, VC oder etwas, das sich schwerer einordnen lässt. Was zählt, ist, was du dort bewegt hast, nicht das Logo. Bachelor oder Master an einer führenden Hochschule (z. B. Mannheim, WHU, St. Gallen, ESB Reutlingen, TUM, Frankfurt School, Goethe Uni), Wirtschaft, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar - im Anschluss ans Praktikum bald in Vollzeit verfügbar Du strukturierst schneller, als das Problem wächst, kommunizierst präzise und trittst sicher auf Sicher in Excel und Google Sheets, mit echtem Instinkt für KI, Software und Automatisierung - du baust dir lieber eigenes Tooling, als nach "more hands" zu fragen Du arbeitest mit Dringlichkeit und gehst in Aktion. Du verantwortest Ergebnisse von Anfang bis Ende, hast Anspruch auch an die unglamourösen Details und bleibst produktiv, ohne auf Anweisung zu warten Du legst denselben Qualitätsanspruch an ein internes Sheet wie an eine Shareholder-Präsentation Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch Du willst nach dem Praktikum bleiben und eine feste Rolle übernehmen Benefits Gründernähe statt Org-Chart: direkt mit Gründer (Ex-Harvard, Ex-BCG) und C-Level, du lernst Entscheidungslogik aus erster Reihe Echte Verantwortung: eigene Themen mit Wirkung, kein Kaffeekochen, kein Schattenprojekt Klarer Übernahmepfad: das Praktikum ist der Einstieg in eine feste Rolle, mit Weg in eine Senior-Operating-Rolle, wenn wir skalieren Breites Lernfeld: Analytics, Operations, Recruiting und Klinikaufbau in einem Setup, selten in dieser Bandbreite Schlankes, schnelles Team: kurze Wege, viel Output, wenig Politik Growth Phase: du gestaltest eine dynamische Wachstumsphase aktiv mit und siehst unmittelbar, was deine Arbeit bewegt Gute Vergütung sowie flexible, hybride Arbeitsweise; Standort Berlin Wenn du in kurzer Zeit viel bewegen und am Aufbau einer wachsenden Klinikgruppe mitbauen willst, bewirb dich. Ein paar Sätze, warum gerade du, reichen - wir achten auf Substanz, nicht auf Form. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></h3> <p>You will report to the VP & GM EU Center and work closely with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Advocacy, Supply Chain and Finance, as well as global commercial teams, to drive strategic initiatives that support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients with genetic diseases and genetically driven cancers. Your primary purpose will be to build and lead the commercial organisation in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, preparing and executing the launches in ADH1 and achondroplasia and building the foundation for future indications. You will lead the field force, including Disease Network Specialists who will move into Key Account Manager roles after launch, and drive the local adaptation of disease awareness and marketing materials, the local execution of customer service offerings, and forecasting and demand planning, with a focus on pre-launch readiness in 2027, followed by launch execution and growth. This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality execution and impact. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in rare disease commercial leadership and launch execution with strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.</p> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Field force leadership: Build, lead and develop the commercial field team across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, including the move from pre-launch disease education to key account management after launch</li> <li>Launch readiness and execution: Own the commercial launch plans for ADH1 and achondroplasia in each country, and set up a model that can take on future indications</li> <li>Local marketing adaptation: Adapt global disease awareness and marketing materials to local needs, languages and regulations, and take them through local review and approval</li> <li>Customer service offerings: Ensure flawless local execution of HCP service offerings, together with Medical Affairs and external vendors</li> <li>Forecasting and demand planning: Own the local forecast and demand plan, align it with Supply Chain and Finance, and track performance against plan</li> <li>Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with Medical Affairs, Market Access and Patient Advocacy so that launch, access and field activities are coordinated in each country</li> <li>Compliance and governance: Make sure all commercial activities comply with HWG, the Austrian Medicines Act (AMG), the Swiss Therapeutic Products Act (HMG) and the industry codes in each country, and that clear boundaries are kept with medical activities</li> </ul> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Where You’ll Work</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>This is a field-based leadership role based in Germany, ideally in the Munich area, covering Germany, Austria and Switzerland</li> <li>Approximately 50% travel is anticipated for field visits, customer meetings, congresses and internal meetings, including regular visits to our Zug office</li> </ul> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who You Are</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine or business. An advanced degree (MBA, PhD, PharmD) is a plus</li> <li>At least 12 years of commercial experience in pharma or biotech, including at least 5 years leading field teams, ideally in rare diseases, endocrinology or paediatrics</li> <li>Proven track record of at least one successful launch in Germany, ideally a rare disease or orphan drug launch, with experience in Austria and/or Switzerland a strong plus</li> <li>Positive, inspiring and tenacious leader, experienced in biotech build-out environments, solution-driven and hands-on, with high integrity</li> <li>Solid knowledge of forecasting, demand planning and P&L management, and of how pricing and reimbursement (AMNOG, EKO, SL) shape the commercial plan</li> <li>Comfortable using digital engagement channels and driving productivity with AI tools</li> <li>Fluent German, and fluent English to work effectively with international and US-based colleagues</li> <li>Willingness to travel approximately 50% of the time</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>We have high expectations for our team members. title: Solution Architect, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About Zinier</h2> <p>80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?</p> <p>Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.</p> <p>We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.</p></div><h2>What we are looking for</h2> <p>If you’re a Solution Architect with a proven track record of transforming complex technical requirements into well-structured, customer-centric solutions, we’d love to meet you. Experience in Field Service Management is a must, particularly in defining system specifications and identifying opportunities to optimize solutions. You should also bring experience working on business transformation programs where product-based solutions must be adapted and scaled to fit dynamic environments.</p> <p>We’re looking for people who thrive in agile, collaborative, global teams and who enjoy working with best-in-class technology to deliver meaningful impact.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Partner with lead solution architects to gather and analyze business and technical requirements, define solution scope, and document processes.</li> <li>Facilitate workshops, customer meetings, and design sessions to align stakeholders on solution design.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product, development, and cross-functional teams to design scalable, customer-aligned solutions.</li> <li>Define and maintain technical implementation documentation (e.g., Low-Level Designs).</li> <li>Evaluate, configure, and customize product features while ensuring integration and implementation best practices.</li> title: Director Production Engineering (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>Mission Brief </strong></p> <p>As Director of Production Engineering, you are accountable for the end-to-end production engineering capability across all manufacturing operations. Your mission is to industrialize development outputs into repeatable, scalable, and compliant serial production, ensuring manufacturing readiness, process stability, quality, cost efficiency, and on-time delivery. You lead the team that converts early procedures into robust production standards, embeds them in PLM/MES systems, and drives continuous improvement across the factory.</p> <p>You act as the primary interface between Engineering (design & development) and Manufacturing (production & operations)—ensuring requirements, procedures, tooling, documentation, test strategies, and digital manufacturing infrastructure are aligned for high-rate, high-quality execution. </p> <p>Your Role in Our Space Mission: </p> <p><strong>1) Production engineering strategy & leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and execute the production engineering roadmap, including industrialization strategy, standardization, and scalability for serial production.</li> <li>Lead and develop a team of production/process/manufacturing engineers; set goals, coaching plans, hiring needs, and performance standards.</li> <li>Establish clear governance for process ownership, engineering change implementation, and cross-functional decision-making.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2) Assembly, integration & test (AIT) process ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own manufacturing process definition across:</li> <ul> <li>Assembly: mechanical/electrical build procedures, torque specs, critical process parameters, work instructions.</li> <li>Integration: subsystem integration strategy (e.g., avionics, propulsion, communications), sequencing, interfaces, and acceptance criteria.</li> <li>Testing: functional, subsystem, and system-level test strategy; test readiness, execution plans, and readiness (NPI / transfer to production)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coordinate with development teams to receive initial procedures and convert them into production-ready standards (control plans, critical-to-quality characteristics where relevant).</li> <li>Drive manufacturing readiness reviews, line readiness, and process qualification for new products, variants, or upgrades.</li> <li>Lead the “first builds”/pilot runs, capturing learnings and stabilizing procedures for volume execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>4) Digital manufacturing (PLM/MES) & configuration control</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the production engineering contribution to PLM/MES:</li> <ul> <li>Translate procedures into structured digital work instructions.</li> <li>Ensure traceability, configuration control, and alignment of as-built data.</li> </ul> <li>Oversee creation and maintenance of:</li> <ul> <li>mBOM (Manufacturing Bill of Materials)</li> <li>BOP (Bill of Process)</li> <li>Routings, work centers, and Documentation, compliance & quality partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure complete, consistent documentation for:</li> <ul> <li>Work instructions, process specifications, test reports, NCRs (non-conformance reports), deviations/waivers, and as-built configurations.</li> </ul> <li>Partner with Quality to build robust nonconformance management and corrective action systems (root cause, containment, RCCA & PA).</li> <li>Ensure processes meet applicable regulatory, customer, and internal compliance requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>6) Cross-functional execution & production support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as senior escalation point for technical blockers in production: diagnose recurring issues, direct corrective actions, and prevent reoccurrence.</li> <li>Align with Supply Chain and Operations on:</li> <ul> <li>Kitting strategy, material availability, critical path timelines, and constraint removal.</li> </ul> <li>Coordinate engineering support coverage and readiness for shifts, rate increases, and critical campaigns.</li> </ul> <p><strong>7) Continuous improvement, cost & throughput</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support Lean Team on Lean/CI initiatives to improve:</li> <ul> <li>Yield, cycle time, takt adherence, OEE, scrap/rework reduction, and labor efficiency.</li> </ul> <li>Establish KPIs and operating mechanisms (tier meetings, weekly business reviews) to track and improve production engineering performance.</li> <li>Build business cases for capital investments (test equipment, tooling, automation) and manage the budget for your scope.</li> certification matrices, standardized visual work instructions, and lessons-learned libraries.</li> </ul> <li>Ensure procedures are systematically categorized, version-controlled, and easily accessible to production teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Success measures (typical KPIs)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Improved first-pass yield, reduced NCR rate, reduced rework hours</li> <li>Reduced cycle time and complete traceability / as-built compliance</li> <li>High team engagement, retention, and capability maturity</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualification Checklist </strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or description: <p> </p> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Revenue Accounting Manager,</strong> ideally a candidate with a passion for systems accounting, to drive revenue recognition process, decisions, systems and reporting.</p> <p>In our finance function we aspire to set the industry pace for speed and accuracy of reporting. Perhaps unusually we <strong>prefer a leader with deep personal interest in the software and technology industry, and ideally some data analytics and software engineering experience</strong>. We expect to grow a team focused on revenue, with a particular emphasis on systems and automation, that puts us at the top of the leaderboard for clarity, correctness, transparency and speed of reporting as a global tech company.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Additional, optional skills we value</h3> <ul> <li>Public company reporting and revenue accounting experience</li> <li>Software implementation, integration and user acceptance</li> <li>Software engineering qualification or experience</li> <li>A passion for technology and a desire to work with motivated colleagues</li> <li>MBA or other relevant business degree</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. description: Your Mission This is a company built for growth. Office Openings: Lead the opening of our new Hamburg HQ and our Berlin office as brand moments, inside and outside the company. PR: Steer our PR partners day to day, set priorities and turn our events and milestones into stories worth covering. Internal Events & Merch: Shape the concept and experience of our internal events, with our Office Management team running the operations, and decide what merch and swag we produce, why and when, together with our Brand team. Budget & Commercial Impact: Manage event budgets and suppliers, work with Sales and Account Management to turn every event into partner meetings and opportunities, and measure what each event and campaign delivers, so every euro is spent on impact rather than attendance. Proven Delivery: You've planned and delivered conference presences, side events and corporate events end to end, including budgets, vendors and on-site execution. Experience working with PR agencies or media is a plus. Taste & Ideas: You know the difference between an event people attend and one they talk about, and you have the ideas to create the second kind. Hands-On & Organized: You move easily between the big picture and the details, and you stay calm when things change at the last minute. Communication Skills: Full professional fluency in English and German, and willingness to travel internationally. How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail. See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved. Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes. Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. We want to be honest about what this job is. It is a hands-on operator role: managing engineers, building the hiring machine, setting standards, running compliance, and working closely with our partners at SAP. If you light up at making an organization fast rather than at owning the biggest possible headcount, this is your role. What you'll do Directly manage and grow the engineering team, including building out its management layer. Build the hiring machine: run hiring operations across our hiring managers, design interview loops that hold up in the AI era, and keep a very high bar while the team grows. Own engineering standards and velocity: how we review, test, and ship - and how the team gets real leverage from AI coding tools. You have owned platform or infrastructure scope at scale: serving, APIs, availability, cloud and vendor budgets. You have worked in both startups and large organizations - you can create structure from scratch and hold your own with a very large partner. You scaled an engineering org through a real growth phase (25 to 60+ or similar), building the management layer along the way. You have led engineering in a research- or ML-heavy organization and know how research code and production code differ - and how to bridge them without slowing research down. title: System Architect
description: Are you an experienced System Architect with a passion for intelligent building management systems, industrial automation, and safety-critical applications? At Deerns, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative and challenging projects that contribute to a smarter, safer, and more sustainable future. Read on and discover how you can make an impact. The challenge The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes. This position involves developing safe, efficient, and future-ready systems that connect various installations, such as HVAC, lighting, access control, gas safety, and industrial process control. You will work closely with project teams, suppliers, and end-users to create innovative and sustainable solutions that meet the highest safety standards. Your responsibilities include: Developing automation architectures: Design scalable solutions for intelligent building management and process automation, including gas detection systems, safety mechanisms, and process control. System integration: Connect installations using protocols like BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and industrial standards such as OPC UA and PROFIBUS. Gas safety and process safety: Develop solutions for gas detection, emergency shutdowns, ventilation integration, and fail-safe control systems for industrial environments. Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations. Process optimization: Analyze and optimize industrial processes and systems to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability. Stakeholder management: Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including clients, end-users, engineers, and project managers, ensuring solutions meet both functional and technical requirements. Continuous learning and development: Stay updated on the latest innovations in smart technologies and automation, applying these to develop improved, future-proof solutions. • Technological consulting: Identify innovations to enhance performance and reliability in intelligent buildings and industrial environments. Documentation and communication: Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. Required Skills and Competencies: Extensive knowledge of intelligent building management solutions, gas safety systems, and industrial process control. Expertise in communication standards and protocols such as KNX, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, and PROFIBUS. Proficiency in designing fail-safe systems and safety-critical applications. Experience with IT networks and cybersecurity in automation environments. Strong analytical skills and problem-solving abilities. Flexibility and the ability to continuously adapt to technological advancements. Excellent communication skills to clearly present complex technical issues Education and Experience: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Technology, or a related field. Relevant experience in intelligent building management solutions, industrial automation, and safety-critical systems. This role combines technological innovation with safety-critical applications. As a System Architect, you will develop integrated solutions that maximize comfort, safety, efficiency, and sustainability in both buildings and industrial processes. We offer A position of 32-40 hours per week with a salary to match. Challenging projects for leading clients in the Netherlands and internationally. A work environment in which innovation and sustainability are put into practice daily. Attention to your own development and vitality with ample training and development opportunities, bicycle and sports arrangements, flexible working hours, 33 vacation days and the possibility of purchasing additional days. Hybrid working, where you have the opportunity to alternate between working from home and the office. A team where cooperation and collegiality are priority, and where we interact informally. Sustainability is in our genes. This is expressed, for example, in a mobility policy where health and sustainability are most important. Many of our offices are located near public transport hubs, cycling is encouraged, and your travel expenses are reimbursed 100% on the basis of public transport. About Deerns As an independent engineering firm, Deerns specializes in consultancy, design and implementation supervision in the fields of installation engineering, building physics, energy supply and sustainability. Our areas of expertise contribute to sustainable, intelligent and future-proof buildings that optimally support our clients' processes. We are responsible for designing the installations and realizing good comfort and a pleasant climate in a wide variety of buildings; from offices, to airports and from hospitals to data centers. In addition, Deerns has been named a World Class Workplace for 2026! Want to know more? Would you like to know more about working at Deerns? title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Foundations
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business. Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling. It's an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you'll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas. Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we'd expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning. This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It's especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains. What you'll be doing Owning the Foundation: the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day. Evolving Our Micro-Frontend Architecture : improve composition, isolation, and shared dependency strategies so feature teams can move fast. Long-Term Thinking: Balance short-term feature unblockers with the long-term health, security, and maintainability of the platform. Agentic Development: Build the foundations that let AI agents work autonomously on our platform, including agent instructions, reusable skills, tool integrations, guardrails, and the automated checks that make agent-authored changes safe to ship. AI Fluency: Work agent-first in your own day-to-day: delegate implementation to agents, and focus your judgment on direction, architecture, and verifying outcomes. 📍This role can be based in our Berlin tech hub. Solid backend knowledge, comfortable owning and operating Node.js services that support frontend infrastructure. Strong knowledge of frontend build tools, bundlers, and module systems, and the ability to evolve them as the platform grows. Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex performance, reliability, or DX issues in large frontend codebases. title: Marketing & Communications Manager (m/w/d)
description: Du möchtest nicht einfach Marketing machen. Du möchtest etwas bewegen. Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und aus guten Ideen etwas Konkretes zu machen? Du bist neugierig, stellst Fragen und probierst auch mal neue Wege aus? Und Du findest, dass gute Ergebnisse am besten gemeinsam entstehen? Dann könnten wir gut zusammenpassen. Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur einen Marketingplan abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt, Dinge hinterfragt und Lust hat, mit uns etwas zu gestalten. Dabei glauben wir an klare Worte, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und hohe Ansprüche an unsere Arbeit. Wir nehmen unsere Aufgaben ernst – uns selbst aber nicht immer. Und wir sind überzeugt, dass Professionalität und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören. Über OIXIO OIXIO gehört zu den führenden IT-Anbietern Estlands – einem Land, das wie kaum ein anderes in Europa für gelebte Digitalisierung und einen hohen Stellenwert von Cybersecurity steht. Was dort über viele Jahre gewachsen ist, bringen wir jetzt verstärkt nach Deutschland: technologische Kompetenz, pragmatische Lösungen, direkte Zusammenarbeit und die Überzeugung, dass gute Digitalisierung vor allem eines tun muss – funktionieren. Mit OIXIO erminas verbinden wir diesen estnischen Spirit mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung mit deutschen Hidden Champions im Mittelstand und unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre IT sicher, verlässlich und zukunftsfähig aufzustellen – von Cybersecurity und IT-Infrastruktur über Business-Anwendungen und Cloud bis zu Daten, KI und Industrial IoT. In Deutschland stehen wir mit unserer gemeinsamen Geschichte noch am Anfang – und kaum jemand kennt hier bisher unseren Namen. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der das ändern will und lieber etwas aufbaut, als eine fertige Rolle zu übernehmen. Die Aufgabe Als Marketing & Communications Manager Deutschland machst Du OIXIO bei mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen bekannt und vertrauenswürdig – vor allem in Norddeutschland und Nordrhein-Westfalen – und schaffst die Gespräche, auf denen unser Vertrieb aufbaut. Du entwickelst unsere Botschaften für den deutschen Markt und übersetzt unser Angebot in klare Geschichten für IT, Produktion und Geschäftsführung. Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Account Manager steuerst Du gezielte Kampagnen für eine definierte Liste von Zielunternehmen und machst aus Interesse konkrete Gespräche. Du baust die Präsenz von OIXIO auf LinkedIn auf – für das Unternehmen sowie für unsere Expertinnen, Experten und Geschäftsführung. Du pflegst Kontakte zu Fach- und Regionalmedien und platzierst Artikel, Fachbeiträge und Kundengeschichten. Du organisierst eigene Veranstaltungen – vom Kundenfrühstück im Werk über Webinare bis zu Roundtables – und wählst die Messen und Netzwerkveranstaltungen aus, auf denen wir präsent sind. Du erstellst Inhalte, die überzeugen: Case Studies, One-Pager, Präsentationen, Videos und Webinhalte – gemeinsam mit unseren Fachleuten in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen. Du misst, was wirkt – Website-Besuche, Anfragen, Veranstaltungsteilnahmen, aktivierte Zielunternehmen und Vertriebstermine – und steuerst Deine Aktivitäten in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM. Unsere Themen: Cybersecurity, Informationssicherheit, Managed IT Services, Microsoft Business Central/NAV-Modernisierung, Prozessdigitalisierung, Industrial IoT, Cloud, Daten und KI. Was Du mitbringen solltest Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing oder in der Unternehmenskommunikation, idealerweise mit IT-Services, Managed Services, Industrieautomation, Beratung oder Business-Anwendungen. Nachweisbare Erfolge darin, Sichtbarkeit aufzubauen und Nachfrage zu erzeugen – gerne auch als erste oder einzige Marketingverantwortliche in einem Unternehmen oder Markt. Erfahrung mit Kampagnen für konkrete Zielunternehmen und mehrere Entscheiderinnen und Entscheider auf Kundenseite. Gutes Verständnis für mittelständische Unternehmen, besonders im industriellen Umfeld, und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären. Starke Schreibkompetenz, sicherer Umgang mit LinkedIn, CRM und Web-Analytics, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gutes Englisch. Du kennst die wichtigsten Werkzeuge des modernen B2B-Marketings und weißt, wie Du ihre Wirkung misst. Ob Dynamics 365, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Analytics, SEO-Tools oder KI: Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Du jedes Tool bereits beherrschst, sondern dass Du weißt, was Du erreichen willst, und Dich schnell in neue Werkzeuge einarbeiten kannst. Flexibler Wohnort in Norddeutschland, sofern regelmäßige persönliche Treffen mit dem Team in unserem Büro in Oldenburg gut möglich sind; Reisebereitschaft deutschlandweit, gelegentlich auch nach Estland und Litauen. Was gut zu uns passt Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen. Ein komplett bestelltes Feld brauchst Du nicht – im Gegenteil: Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, entwickelst Ideen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, daraus etwas zu machen. Du bist neugierig auf Menschen, Unternehmen und Technologien und willst verstehen, bevor Du kommunizierst. Du schätzt Flexibilität, möchtest aber nicht ausschließlich im Homeoffice arbeiten. Der persönliche Austausch im Team, mit unseren Kunden und mit der Presse ist Dir wichtig. Du kannst die Stärke und Erfahrung einer etablierten internationalen IT-Gruppe nutzen und gleichzeitig mit uns herausfinden, was davon für den deutschen Mittelstand wirklich relevant ist. Du arbeitest eigenständig, aber nicht als Einzelkämpfer. Bei uns ist Marketing Teamsport: Gute Ergebnisse entstehen gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Consultants, Technik und Geschäftsführung. Du misst Deinen Erfolg at Gesprächen und Kunden – nicht an Likes – und versprichst nichts, was unser Team nicht halten kann. Und Du hast Lust, ein Stück des OIXIO Spirits aus Estland nach Deutschland zu bringen – und ihm hier gemeinsam mit uns eine eigene Handschrift zu geben. Was wir bieten Eine konkrete Rolle beim Aufbau von OIXIO in Deutschland – mit Gestaltungsspielraum und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Ein echtes Budget für Veranstaltungen, Inhalte und Medienarbeit sowie Unterstützung durch Spezialisten, wo es nötig ist. Erfahrene Fachleute in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen, die Inhalte, Demos und Vorträge beisteuern. Ein breites Leistungsportfolio rund um IT, Cybersecurity, Digitalisierung, Business-Anwendungen und Industrial IoT – mit vielen Geschichten, die erzählt werden wollen. Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit estnischer Bodenständigkeit, direkter Kommunikation und pragmatischer Zusammenarbeit. Wir erwarten viel und geben auch viel zurück: Vertrauen, Freiraum, faire Bedingungen und Menschen, auf die Du Dich verlassen kannst. Warum diese Rolle interessant ist Deutschland ist für OIXIO ein wichtiger Wachstumsmarkt. Mit unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg, einem erfahrenen Team und einem relevanten Angebot passen wir gut zu den Herausforderungen vieler mittelständischer Industrieunternehmen – jetzt muss es der Markt nur noch erfahren. Wenn Du Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing mitbringst, Lust hast, eine Marke von Grund auf bekannt zu machen, und lieber mit einem guten Team als mit großen Schlagworten arbeitest, freuen wir uns auf das Gespräch mit Dir. Informationen und Bewerbung Für Rückfragen zur Rolle und zum weiteren Prozess kannst Du Dich gerne direkt an uns wenden: Dr. Yvette Teiken: ----- Folkert Wierda: ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial, Italy
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Fluency in Italian - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. title: Customer Experience Manager - Russian Speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. <li> <p>2+ years of industry experience, with experience in cloud security and/or performance industries preferred.</p> </li> <li> <p>Bachelor's degree and/or other professional qualifications.</p> </li> <li> <p>Direct experience in commercial sales, negotiation, and deal closure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of or willingness to learn about computer networking and “how the internet works,” with network security a plus.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage and prioritize competing portfolio demands, aligning internal resources with the highest-impact commercial and retention goals</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise in SaaS retention and sales process and excellent knowledge of value driven sales.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent problem solving skills with the ability to creatively achieve resolutions.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="2">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated description: Sie möchten Quartiere mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert entwickeln und der „gerechten Sache“ statt der bloßen Rendite dienen? Sie brennen für regeneratives, ressourcenschonendes und zirkuläres Bauen, bei dem Sie die Wirksamkeit Ihrer eigenen Arbeit jeden Tag im Stadtbild sehen. Dann gestalten Sie als Senior Projektsteuerer die Zukunft des Bauens aktiv mit – inklusive Firmenwagen, großer Gestaltungsfreiheit und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Sie wünschen sich Projekte, bei denen Mensch, Natur und Gebäude im Einklang stehen und Sie nicht nur ausführen, sondern frühzeitig steuern? Sie suchen ein Umfeld ohne starre Konzernstrukturen, in dem Sie eine ganz neue Abteilung maßgeblich mit aufbauen und eigene Ideen einbringen können? Zudem ist Ihnen eine vertrauensvolle Kultur wichtig, die Fehler als Lernchance für Innovationen begreift? Dann erwartet Sie hier ein Arbeitsplatz, der genau diese Werte lebt. Ihr zukünftiger Arbeitgeber ist eine junge, eigentümergeführte Aktiengesellschaft mit Sitz in Münster, die sich auf die Entwicklung, Planung und den langfristigen Betrieb nachhaltiger Quartiere spezialisiert hat. Ein starkes, interdisziplinäres Team arbeitet hier mit dem klaren Anspruch, soziale, ökologische und wirtschaftliche Qualität zu lebenswerten Räumen zu verbinden. Flache Hierarchien, Innovationsfreude und eine vertrauensvolle Teamkultur prägen den Arbeitsalltag dieses wachsenden Unternehmens. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt auf diese unbefristete Stelle als Senior Projektsteuerer (m/w/d) | 85.000-100.000 € + Firmenwagen Ihre Perspektiven Bauen mit Sinn & Nachhaltigkeit: Hier steht die „gerechte Sache“ im Fokus. Sie arbeiten an Quartieren, die die Zukunft gestalten, durch regeneratives, ressourcenschonendes und zirkuläres Bauen. Echte Wirksamkeit & Aufbauarbeit: Als Pionier im Unternehmen prägen Sie die Prozesse und bauen Ihren eigenen Bereich aktiv mit auf – ganz ohne festgefahrene Konzernstrukturen. Verantwortung & Vertrauen: Sie agieren als Berater auf Augenhöhe. Mit kurzen Wegen zur Geschäftsführung genießen Sie größtmöglichen Entscheidungsspielraum für Ihre Projekte. Work-Life-Balance & Flexibilität: Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2-3 Tagen Home-Office, Vertrauensarbeitszeit sowie 30 Urlaubstagen bietet Ihnen maximale zeitliche Flexibilität. Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: Neben einem Firmenwagen zur Privatnutzung erwarten Sie modernstes Equipment (Apple oder Lenovo) und hervorragende persönliche Entwicklungsperspektiven bis hin zur Leitungsfunktion. Ihre Aufgaben Sie übernehmen die technische Steuerung anspruchsvoller Quartiersentwicklungen in der Planungs- und Realisierungsphase. Sie entwickeln Realisierungsstrategien in enger und vertrauensvoller Zusammenarbeit mit der Projektentwicklung. Sie verantworten die Gesamtbaukosten und stellen die konsequente Einhaltung von Kosten-, Termin- und Qualitätszielen sicher. Sie organisieren, verhandeln und vergeben Bauleistungen an potenzielle Realisierungspartner (GU- und Einzelvergaben). Sie übernehmen das souveräne Stakeholdermanagement mit Nutzern, Planern, Investoren und Behörden während der Ausführungsphase. Sie integrieren regenerative und ressourcenschonende Bauweisen aktiv in den Realisierungsprozess. Sie wenden Vertragsrecht, HOAI, VOB, AHO sowie einschlägige DIN-Normen rechtssicher an. Sie bauen die neue technische Abteilung proaktiv auf und entwickeln Prozesse sowie Werkzeuge für Ihr Team. Ihr Profil Studienabschluss in Architektur oder Bauingenieurwesen oder Projektmanagement Alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, beispielsweise als Handwerksmeister:in mit entsprechenden Referenzen Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung als Projektsteuerer, Projektleiter oder Bauleiter in der Bau- und Immobilienwirtschaft. Einschlägige Projekterfahrung im Hochbau oder Schlüsselfertigbau Wünschenswert sind Kenntnisse im Tiefbau Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Abwicklung von Bauprojekten Sichere Anwenderkenntnisse in HOAI, VOB, AHO und gängigem Vertragsrecht Affinität zu regenerativen und ressourcenschonenden Bauweisen Deutsch: C1 Intrinsische Motivation für nachhaltiges Bauen und ausgeprägtes Interesse an Brancheninnovationen Gültiger Pkw-Führerschein Bereitschaft zur regelmäßigen Präsenz vor Ort in Münster (hybrides Modell) Interessiert? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt unkompliziert bei Ihrem Ansprechpartner Mirijam Broghammer. Ihre Beratung durch Riverstate ist für Sie selbstverständlich kostenlos. Der Bewerbungsprozess ist schlank gehalten: In der Regel findet nur ein einziges Gespräch direkt mit der Fachabteilung und der Geschäftsführung statt. the platform should offer next.</li> <li>Measure adoption, reliability, cost, and impact, and use that data in planning and when reporting to leadership.</li> <li>Manage the cost of AI usage and tooling, including budgets, licences, vendor relationships, and build-versus-buy decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Shape the technical direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the team's tech leads on platform and the company's use of AI secure and compliant.</li> <li>Help engineering teams across Raisin adopt AI in their work through documentation, workshops, and direct support.</li> </ul> profiling).</p> <p><strong><u>Missions & Rôle :</u></strong></p> <p>Au sein du <strong>Service Études</strong> de Conexance et rattaché directement au <strong>Senior Lead Data Analyst</strong>, vous intégrez une équipe dynamique et collaborative de 7 collaborateurs (Lead Data Analyst, Data Analysts, prestataires et alternant).</p> <p>Dans un contexte résolument <em>Customer Centric</em>, vous intervenez en support direct du commerce (FR et UK) afin de produire, analyser et restituer des études statistiques à forte valeur ajoutée.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités clés :</strong></p> externes.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Profil recherché :</u></strong></p> <p>Vous êtes passionné par la statistique et la valorisation de la donnée marketing, avec un tempérament curieux, proactif et un excellent relationnel.</p> <p><strong>Formation & Expérience :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Formation :</strong> Titulaire d’un <strong>Master 2 / Bac+5</strong> en Statistiques, Machine Learning,
