title: PLC Software Engineer - The Netherlands
description: Ready to build the software behind real-world renewable energy installations? At Bright Renewables, your PLC software doesn’t stay behind a desk. You’ll see it come to life in complex industrial installations for renewable gas and CO₂ technologies. As a PLC Software Engineer , you’ll be involved in the complete automation lifecycle - from software design and programming to testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions, help shape our automation standards, and work alongside experienced colleagues as part of an international software engineering team of around 10 engineers. Together, you’ll collaborate across the Netherlands, Latvia, and Poland to develop and deliver reliable, innovative automation solutions. Why this role? You’ll get the opportunity to: Own your solutions - contribute to software solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from design and programming to testing and commissioning; Work on real installations - solve automation challenges in complex renewable energy plants; Have technical influence - contribute to software standards, templates, concepts, and ways of working, within a team that values collaboration and embraces innovative ideas from everyone; Keep developing - work alongside experienced Electrical and Software Engineers and continue building your technical expertise; Work internationally - collaborate with colleagues and project teams in the Netherlands, Poland, Latvia and beyond, including regular international travel to visit our offices and project sites; Choose what works for you - work 32 or 40 hours per week, with flexible starting times and opportunities to work from home; Make an impact - use your automation expertise in technologies that contribute directly to the energy transition. What will you do? As a PLC Software Engineer, you design, develop, test, and commission PLC and SCADA control systems for technologies such as gas upgrading and CO₂ liquefaction. You report directly to the Manager E&I and Software and work closely with Electrical Engineers, Process Engineers and fellow Software Engineers . Depending on your experience, you’ll also have the opportunity to take more technical ownership, contribute to software concepts and standards, and support colleagues with complex automation challenges. Your responsibilities include: Designing, programming, testing, and commissioning PLC and SCADA systems ; Developing control software for gas upgrading, CO₂ liquefaction, and other renewable energy technologies; Taking ownership of your software from engineering through commissioning; Testing and troubleshooting software during commissioning and operation; Analyzing and resolving software and control-related issues in existing installations; Implementing software updates and optimizations; Supporting Service Engineers with more complex automation and software questions; Contributing to software standards, templates, and automation concepts; Working closely with Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, and other technical disciplines; Sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues within the engineering team. What do you bring? We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to take responsibility for their own engineering work. Ideally, you have: A completed technical education in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field; Several years of experience in PLC/SCADA engineering within an industrial environment; Hands-on experience in PLC programming, ideally with Siemens S7 and TIA Portal, combined with knowledge of WinCC SCADA, industrial communication networks, and remote access solutions. Experience with commissioning and troubleshooting industrial installations; A good understanding of automation architectures and industrial control systems; Good command of English, both spoken and written; Knowledge of OT security is a plus. What’s in it for you? We want to give you the technical freedom and working environment to do your best engineering work. You can expect: A competitive salary based on your experience and technical background; The option to work 32 or 40 hours per week; Flexible starting times between 7:00 and 9:00 a.m. ; Ample opportunities to work from home, including a one-time €250 allowance to set up your home office; An attractive annual profit-sharing scheme for employees with at least 12 months of service; An excellent pension scheme; 8% annual holiday allowance; A commuting allowance of €0.23 per kilometer, in accordance with our employment conditions; A high level of autonomy and responsibility; Plenty of opportunities for technical and professional development; An international engineering environment with both experienced professionals and engineers earlier in their careers; The opportunity to work with renewable energy technologies and contribute directly to the energy transition; A bike lease program and rewards for cycling to work; A modern, sustainably built working environment in Hengelo. About Bright Renewables Bright Renewables develops and delivers technologies for renewable gas and CO₂ capture, providing solutions from engineering and realization through to service and maintenance. Our installations convert biogas into renewable natural gas and capture, purify, and liquefy CO₂ for industrial reuse. We are part of HoSt Group , a family-owned Dutch company operating internationally in renewable energy technology. For you, that means working on international projects with the opportunities of a global organization, while keeping the short communication lines, technical freedom, and personal approach of a family-owned company. Interested? We’d like to get to know you. Apply by submitting your CV and motivation through the application button. Within 14 days, we’ll let you know whether we’d like to invite you for an interview. Would you first like to know more about the technology, team, or day-to-day work? Contact Wybren Broersma, Manager E&I and Software, or Natalia Wisniewska, Corporate Recruiter, at +31 88 460 90 80. Build software. See it running. Make an impact on renewable energy. title: AI Engineer
description: Who are we? Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence. Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses. Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore. How we work Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data. Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer. Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted. What will you do? The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents. The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead. The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real. Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins. Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view. Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks. title: Head of Platform (Infrastructure & DevOps)
description: What we are building Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start. Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence. We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group. Our team Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI. Your mission Mimica is growing fast, and so is the demand on our Platform Team. As Head of Platform, you will lead a lean but highly capable team that is the backbone of every engineering squad in the company, and you will own the infrastructure strategy, including all AI infrastructure, as we scale. The Platform team services the entire engineering organisation: keeping environments healthy, unblocking teams, building the infrastructure that lets everyone else move faster, and working with teams regarding SRE topics and developer experience too. As you work with us, the role will develop into designing Mimica’s infrastructure strategy at scale. The team has 4 engineers today, around 6 by the end of the year, and 10+ in 2027, so the role has the potential to grow into a “manager of managers” level as the company grows. This is a role with real scope: expanding to multi-region and physically separated database environments, supporting Mimica’s first installable infrastructure component for enterprise, and owning FinOps. One day you are defining the standard menu of deployment options for enterprise customers, the next you are in a security review or an architecture decision on AI infrastructure. We are looking for leaders with either an application development or a systems/infrastructure background. What matters more than your origin story is your hands-on credibility with Kubernetes, IaC, and cloud platforms, your ability to lead engineers and other leaders, and your ability to collaborate closely with Product, ML, Security, Sales and Customer Success. If you want to work in a place where your contributions are visible, your scope is broad, and the problems are real, this is the role for you. Part of your day-to-day Own Mimica's infrastructure strategy and the platform roadmap across all products, with the final call on cloud architecture, deployment models, infra vendors and platform standards. Lead and grow the Platform team: Manage existing Platform and SREs, plan headcount, set goals and metrics, and design the sub-team split (Cloud & Developer Platform, Reliability & SRE, AI Infrastructure) as the team grows. Own all AI infrastructure, including training and serving infra, MLOps tooling, Vertex and model access. Maintain Mimica’s DevEx culture - improve agency for product teams without compromising on compliance, create paved roads for deployments, and identify pain points as they arise. Own the infra and LLM budget, forecast and unit economics, including cost attribution by product and customer and the GCP relationship. Own reliability across engineering: SLOs, on-call model, incident process, postmortems, DR testing and capacity planning. Own the CI/CD and developer platform, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, ArgoCD, Crossplane) and observability standards (Honeycomb, Grafana, Loki). Work with the Platform PM, your peer, to define client needs and turn them into the platform roadmap. Act as the named technical owner for infrastructure in enterprise deals and security reviews, joining high-stakes sales and client calls and coaching your team to take the rest. Guide the craft mentors for infrastructure, MLOps and Python engineering, and set engineering-wide standards for reliability, on-call, CI/CD and craft. Report monthly platform health and costs to leadership, and lead the infrastructure part of technical due diligence. Requirements Proven experience leading engineers , ideally including managing a team lead or other managers, and growing a team through hiring and sub-team design. Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes , whether on GKE (preferred), EKS, OnPrem, or another managed Kubernetes service, across multiple regions. Proven experience with infrastructure-as-code as a core part of your platform, such as Terraform, and with ArgoCD or a comparable GitOps tool. A track record in owning reliability: setting SLOs and SLAs, running on-call, leading incident response and postmortems, and testing disaster recovery. Observability experience with at least one major platform: Honeycomb, Datadog, Grafana, or New Relic. Comfortable with code, and able to review architecture and prototypes hands-on. Experience owning an infrastructure budget, including cloud cost attribution, forecasting and cloud-provider relationships. Experience designing deployment models for enterprise customers (single tenant, regional, data residency) and supporting security reviews and contracted SLAs. Background in startups or scale-ups: you are used to ambiguity, moving fast, and wearing multiple hats. Strong communication and collaboration skills: you can translate infrastructure complexity into clear language for engineers, executives and clients, and you know when to say no to bespoke requests. Bonus / Nice to have Familiarity with Crossplane, or a similar product like Config Connector. Experience with Temporal for workflow orchestration. Security and compliance experience, particularly supporting SOC 2. Experience supporting a funding round, including technical due diligence. What we offer 💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills. 🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix. 💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget 📍 Flexible schedules and location ☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays 🍼 Enhanced parental leave 🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits 📖 Annual learning & development budget 🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials 🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work Note : Some benefits may vary depending on location and role ⚠️ Mimica will only contact candidates from an ----- email address. We do not request banking or sensitive personal information during the recruiting process. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Events Growth Manager

That starts with our flagship conferences, PlatformCon and AgenticCon, the biggest conferences in the platform engineering world, which travel to San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York and Berlin, and extends to our roadshows, roundtables, workshops, House of Kube (the largest party in the cloud native world) and the satellite events we run in cities around major conferences such as AWS re:Invent, KubeCon and Google Cloud Next. Your goal is to bring platform engineering leaders into the room and keep them coming back. This is a systems and relationships role, not a one off campaign role. You’ll build the growth loops, the audience, and the repeatable playbook needed to fill these events and drive high attendance every time. You’ll report to the Head of Growth. What you'll do Own registration and attendance growth for PlatformCon and AgenticCon ticket sales, and for every other event we run, across San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York, Berlin and Amsterdam. Build growth loops and long term relationships with the platform engineering community, its practitioners and its leaders, so we have an audience to pull from in every city. Own our event pages on Luma and the end to end campaigns that fill them. Plan campaigns designed for a high attendance rate, so the right people do not just register but actually show up. Use HubSpot and Luma to build and target the right audience segments for each event. Collaborate with design team to ensure high quality event pages and with content for strong copy and assets. Brief and work with our performance marketing and lifecycle managers to get paid and email support behind each event. Build the systems and the playbook that let us fill these events repeatedly, so the approach compounds instead of starting from scratch each time. What success looks like Within your first 90 days, we want you to come back to us with a proposed playbook: how we should run our in person events, and the exact workflow you would follow every time a new event brief lands, from audience to event page to campaigns to attendance. By 180 days, we want that playbook proven on live events, with a rising attendance rate and a reusable audience building in each city. What you'll bring A systems thinker who works in growth loops, not one off tactics. Experience in B2B SaaS marketing. Even better if you have worked somewhere whose core business is running events. A track record of building and growing audiences and driving real attendance at in person events, not just registrations. Strong hands on experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot for segmentation and targeting. Comfort running social campaigns and briefing paid campaigns. The ability to work independently with complete ownership, and to build a repeatable system rather than firefighting each event. Work closely with the design team to produce strong event visuals, both for our Luma pages and website pages, so every event looks as good as it performs. Comfortable with occasional travel to our event cities when an event calls for it. Nice to have Experience with Luma as an event platform. Experience marketing events for a company whose primary business is events. You do not need experience with data or automation tooling such as zapier, n8n or similar data flow systems. PlatformCon and AgenticCon are the flagship conferences of the entire space, and they travel to San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York and Berlin, alongside a full calendar of roadshows, executive roundtables, AI Platform Leaders events and House of Kube, the largest party in the cloud native world. These rooms bring together senior platform and engineering leaders from some of the biggest companies on the planet, including many from the S&P 500. You would own the growth of all of it end to end, with the mandate to build the audience and the playbook that make these events repeatable, and direct access to the Head of Growth and the wider leadership team. title: Strategy Lead - Acquisition
description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Acquisition Strategy and Tech team is the integrated growth engine for iwoca in Germany. We bridge the gap between high-level commercial strategy and the technical systems that power our customer journey. By combining growth analytics, performance modeling, and full-stack engineering, we own the end-to-end acquisition funnel – from the very first touchpoint to a completed loan application. Our Core Focus: Strategic Growth & Analytics: We serve as the central hub for our Direct Marketing and Sales channels. We translate complex data into actionable strategies, ensuring our outreach is both scalable and profitably managed. Technical Infrastructure: We build and maintain the proprietary systems and models that drive our German operations. This includes optimizing the "User Experience" (UX) to ensure a frictionless onboarding process for small businesses. Operational Excellence: We connect the dots between data-driven decision-making and real-world commercial impact. Our mission is to ensure every potential customer receives a clear, relevant, and rapid understanding of how iwoca can fund their business. We are a fast-moving, cross-functional unit designed to turn strategic hypotheses into measurable results. Whether it’s refining a marketing model or shipping a new feature in the application journey, we ensure that iwoca’s expansion in the German market is backed by robust tech and a clear commercial North Star. The role This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, data, and technology. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will lead a high-performing, interdisciplinary team of three and own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market. Your primary objective is to co-define the growth strategy and partner closely with engineering and data teams to build the systems, onboarding journeys, and experiments that bring that strategy to life. The scope of this role is broad and we're not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning strategy, analytics, product development, and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions. You'll define hypotheses, lead cross-functional initiatives, and own the roadmap for how iwoca engages with German businesses. You will be accountable for measurable impact on acquisition and conversion, bringing ideas to life through rigorous commercial insight, strong customer empathy, and practical delivery. As a Lead, you will also be responsible for coaching your team and establishing the operating rhythm for this new unit. Market and problem understanding Deeply understand the German SME lending landscape, customer needs, and competitive context to sharpen our go-to-market strategy. Translate market and customer insight into clearly defined product problems and prioritised commercial opportunities. Inform targeting and segmentation strategies to help Marketing and Sales reach the right customers. Product build and optimisation Own the roadmap for acquisition and onboarding, working with engineers and data scientists to develop tools such as lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers, and onboarding journeys. Work with marketing and sales to evolve website content, sign-up flows, and decisioning logic to increase conversion. Influence future team capability by helping define priorities, roles, and processes as we scale. Experimentation and insight Design, run, and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, onboarding tools, and product flows. Identify opportunities using first-principle reasoning supported by data, customer research, and funnel analysis. Cross-functional collaboration Manage, coach, and develop a team of at the beginning two commercial strategy analysts and a data scientist focused on acquisition strategy and operational excellence. Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning engineering, data, marketing, and commercial stakeholders around clear goals, hypotheses, and success metrics. Translate high-level business goals into testable hypotheses and actionable briefs for our technical teams. Help establish the operating rhythm, rituals, and roadmap processes for this new team. The requirements Essential: Strong commercial mindset with proven experience driving go-to-market strategy and measurable acquisition growth. Experience in growth strategy, revenue operations, or a highly analytical commercial role with a track record of driving tech-enabled or product-led growth. Proven people management or team leadership experience, with the ability to build culture and establish operating rhythms in a newly formed team. Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments. Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools. Experience working with (or a strong desire to learn about) technical models such as lead scoring, predictive targeting, or qualification logic. Ability to work from first principles and thrive in ambiguity with curiosity and autonomy. Bonus: Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products. Experience working closely with engineering, product, or data science teams to ship features or models. Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with ridiculous growth-mindset. 26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday. One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years. Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp. iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club. €30 contribution towards the Deutschlandticket. Company Pension with Canada Life. Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg. A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice. Corporate Benefits discounts. ’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone, including a book budget. Learning German budget. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4.5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Partner Acquisition Germany team builds the partner channel through which iwoca reaches small businesses in Germany: comparison platforms and brokers, banks, payment providers, business software providers and financial advisors who offer iwoca's finance to their customers at the moment it is needed. The team works with three partnership models, from a co-branded referral link and a partner portal to a full API integration, and measures its success by partners that are live and funding customers. The team is small and works closely together: the Head of Partner Acquisition Germany, a Strategy & Data Manager who owns market analysis, business cases and the CRM, and the partner managers who own the relationships. The team prioritises partners by strategic fit, works through warm introductions and existing networks wherever possible, and stays close to every new partner until the first customers are funded. It works hand in hand with Relationship Management and the product and engineering teams in London / Berlin / Frankfurt that build the integrations. The role This is a senior role with full ownership of the partners you pursue. Three things matter more than anything else: You will qualify before you sell, because the best partnerships begin with a genuine customer need. You know how to activate networks and create warm introductions rather than relying solely on cold outreach. And you consider a deal complete only when the partnership is live, working well and funding its first customers. You'll travel across Germany one to two days a week for face-to-face partner meetings, industry events and trade fairs. Ownership and impact Own a portfolio of the highest-value partnership prospects in Germany, from first conversation to signed contract and live integration. Lead negotiations with founders, managing directors and heads of product or partnerships at banks, payment providers, business software platforms and financial intermediaries. Design the cooperation model and commercial terms for each partner so that the partnership works for both sides over years, not quarters. Bring every partner to go-live with a committed internal promoter and a first concrete use case, so that your work turns into funded customers and long-term value. Autonomy, backed by a dedicated strategy and data function Spend your time on relationships and deals, with a Strategy & Data Manager who builds target models, business cases and CRM automation alongside you for your prospects and partners. Own your pipeline end to end and keep it transparent, so that forecasts and decisions rest on input and numbers everyone trusts. Decide together with the Head of Partner Acquisition which segments and partners you pursue and where you say no. Influence on product and strategy Feed what you learn from partners directly into our partnership models, the integration roadmap and the go-to-market plan for Germany. Shape the activation playbook for new partners and the handover to Key Account Management together with the Head of Business Development. Represent iwoca at the industry events, trade fairs and partner roundtables that matter for SME finance in Germany. The requirements Essential: At least five years of experience in B2B partnerships, business development or key account management in fintech, banking, payments or business software. You can show a proven track record of closing complex deals with six to twelve month sales cycles at C-Level, founder, board or head-of-department level. A working understanding of how a financing product is integrated into a partner's platform: APIs, embedded finance and how a partner's customer data can be used in the application journey. You won't build integrations yourself (our engineering teams do that), but you need to lead that conversation credibly. Professional fluency in German and English. Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use. Bonus: An existing network among German banks, payment providers, brokers or business software platforms. Experience with lending, working capital or other financial products for small businesses. title: Services Sales Manager, Professional Services, Sydney
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Sydney, Australia</strong></p> <p>The Services Sales Manager (SSM) is a dynamic sales professional, passionate about technology evangelism and developing custom services solutions to drive business growth. This role owns sizing the service component of a Cloudflare opportunity. The SSM takes the technical solution and the customer requirements to deliver a Professional Services commercial proposition presenting customers with a clear line of sight from the solution to measurable business value, and giving sales teams the technical credibility to close.</p> <p>A core objective of the SSM is to grow the Cloudflare professional services business. This involves direct engagement with customers to define the specific service requirements needed to maximize the value of their technology investment and achieve their desired technical and business outcomes.</p> <p>The SSM works in a fast-paced environment and is instrumental in enabling Cloudflare customers to securely achieve their goals. This is accomplished by creating and proposing  a comprehensive services wrapper tailored to meet each customer's unique needs.</p> <p>The SSM maintains close working relationships across the organisation, partnering directly with the Account Teams, Specialist Sales, as well as establishing strong connections with Delivery teams, Global Delivery Practices, and other subject matter experts within Cloudflare Professional Services.</p> <p>The successful candidate will recommend the appropriate blend of Cloudflare services to assist customers in planning and executing large-scale transformations, ensuring they leverage maximum value from the portfolio.</p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with sales teams to clearly define Cloudflare's differentiated approach to Go-to-Market (GTM) services. Showcase our delivery capabilities, IP, and expertise through compelling success stories that demonstrate how we solve customer needs.</li> <li>Gathering, understanding and defining customer specific requirements and expectations for value based outcomes in workshop based scenarios</li> <li>Collaborating with Sales, Delivery and Global Practices to construct solution proposals and Statements of Work to satisfy customer specific scope requirements and outcome based services.</li> <li>Collaborating with the Sales team to drive business growth for Cloudflare Services in your aligned territory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Experience </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record in service sales preferably with delivery experience, working within an IT or Cyber Security services organization</li> <li>Self–motivated and detail–oriented</li> <li>Strong written, verbal and presentation skills</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in discovery/scope definition workshops with cross–functional internal and customer resources to prepare current state/future state roadmaps and services proposals.</li> <li>Experience of working across multiple regions.</li> <li>Cybersecurity experience preferred.</li> <li>Experience and familiarity with using SFDC or similar CRM tools</li> <li>Cloudflare Platform experience will be an extra asset</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organisations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.</p> <p>As part of our sales team, you are empowered with systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won't find someone at Cloudflare that isn't committed to your success - with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. </p> <p>As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats.</p> <p><strong><br><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. </p> <p><strong>We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.</strong></p> <p>To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to support and drive our Customer Success teams regionally. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success management and an obvious passion for new technologies. </p> <p>You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you will provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You will play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. Comfortable dealing with ambiguity you will be equip to quickly adapt to change. Collaboration with other teams is also vital to this role to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility will be to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work in close collaboration with the Global Head of Customer Success to drive results.</p> <p>We engage with a diverse customer base and follow a diverse set of motions to provide the appropriate and required level of focus for every customer. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the ability to pivot right across this customer base regardless of culture, location or focus.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This opportunity is available in the APAC region and is remote.</p> <p><strong>The role entails:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic planning and analysis:</strong> preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. </li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration: </strong>collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.</li> <li><strong>Documentation and reporting: </strong>you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent academic results at school and university</li> <li>Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject</li> <li>Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries</li> <li>Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results</li> <li>Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific</li> <li>Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration</li> <li>Experience growing and developing a CSM team</li> <li>Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. title: Interesse an admkrs? (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Kurz vorab: Wir schreiben hier keine Stelle aus. Diese Seite ist für Leute, die admkrs kennen, unsere Arbeit verfolgen und einen konkreten Grund haben, warum sie genau hier hingehören. Wenn das auf dich zutrifft, lies weiter. Wenn du gerade an zwanzig Agenturen dieselbe Bewerbung schickst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Ort. Du sagst uns, welche Lücke du bei uns schließt. Nicht wir dir. Wir sind rund 20 Leute in München, arbeiten für Marken wie ESN, arena und asambeauty an Performance-Kampagnen, Creatives, Video und eigener Technologie. Vieles davon ist öffentlich sichtbar: unsere Cases, unsere Creatives, unsere Tools. Schau dir das an und sag uns, wo du andocken würdest und was dadurch bei uns besser wird. Dein Profil Du hast dir admkrs angeschaut und kannst in drei Sätzen sagen, warum wir und nicht irgendeine Agentur. Du hast ein Fachgebiet, in dem du richtig gut bist: Performance Marketing, Creative und Design, Video und Motion, Strategie oder Entwicklung. Du zeigst Arbeit statt Buzzwords. Ein Link zu Projekten, Creatives, Code oder Kampagnen sagt uns mehr als jedes Anschreiben. Du lebst in München oder bist gerade dabei, hierher zu ziehen. Wir arbeiten zusammen im Office am Gärtnerplatz, dafür muss dein Lebensmittelpunkt hier sein. Warum wir? Kurze Wege: Strategie, Design, Video und Performance sitzen an einem Tisch, Feedback kommt in Minuten statt in Tagen. Kreative kennen die Zahlen, Media Buyer die Ideen. Wir entwickeln Arbeit gemeinsam weiter. Eigene Technologie: Unser Entwicklerteam baut Tools, KI-Skills und Schnittstellen für den Alltag. Was fehlt, bauen wir selbst. Ein Office, in das man gern kommt, mitten in München. Darauf schauen wir Wir lesen jede Bewerbung, die hier ankommt, und du bekommst in jedem Fall eine Antwort. Entscheidend sind drei Dinge: ein konkreter Grund für admkrs, sichtbare Arbeit und eine Vorstellung davon, welche Rolle du bei uns ausfüllen willst. Eine allgemeine Bewerbung ohne Bezug zu uns hat hier keine Chance. Das ist nicht unfreundlich gemeint, es spart uns beiden Zeit. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Im Bewerbungsformular fragen wir, warum admkrs und warum du, in welchem Bereich du dich siehst und wo wir deine Arbeit sehen können. Wenn du dich über ein anderes Portal bewirbst, schreib diese Angaben bitte in deine Nachricht oder deinen Lebenslauf. Wir nehmen uns Zeit für die Antwort, das kann ein paar Tage dauern. title: Staff Mechanical Product Engineer (Production)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong><br>The Staff Product Engineer serves as the primary design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. Embedded within the Global Head of Production organization with a dotted-line relationship to Platform and Payload Engineering Teams, this role owns the day-to-day engineering interface between design engineering teams and manufacturing operations across multiple production sites.<br>This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep technical judgement, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production leadership. The Staff Product Engineer is expected to drive systemic improvements — not just resolve individual issues — and to develop process and tooling solutions that scale across product versions, variations, and manufacturing sites.<br><br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><br><strong>Production Floor Engineering Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines</li> <li>Triage and disposition Material Review Board (MRB) actions day-to-day; participate in MRB meetings and drive resolution timelines to minimize production hold time</li> <li>Resolve production process-blockers, design ambiguities, and drawing interpretation issues in real time, exercising engineering judgement within defined authority boundaries</li> <li>Provide rapid-response engineering support to Production, Quality, and Test teams for nonconformance resolution, use-as-is/rework/scrap decisions, and repair dispositions</li> <li>Identify and escalate systemic design issues to core Design Engineering teams with clear problem statements, data, and recommended corrective actions</li> <li>Perform and review mechanical design analyses — including structural stress, fatigue life, thermal, and tolerance stackup calculations — to support MRB dispositions, deviation requests, and use-as-is justifications</li> <li>Utilize 3D CAD tools (e.g., SolidWorks, NX, or CATIA) to evaluate proposed rework paths, model design modifications, and generate or revise engineering drawings as needed to support production</li> <li>Apply knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes — including metals, composites, adhesive bonding, welding, brazing, and surface treatments — to assess nonconformances and recommend technically sound repair or rework methods</li> </ul> <p><strong>Design Intent Translation & Multi-Site Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bridge the translation of design title: Marketing Analyst
description: As Marketing Analyst, you will own the full marketing intelligence cycle across all 14 of our markets, from reliable web tracking and clean data collection to decision-driven dashboards, incrementality measurement, and the steering logic our growth teams rely on. Based in Berlin, you will be the person who ensures marketing decisions are grounded in accurate data, and you will help answer where the next Euro of media spend should go to maximise revenue, margin, and efficiency. This is a role with genuine scope to build the marketing analytics function and grow into senior analytics leadership as PERGOLUX expands. PERGOLUX designs and delivers premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees and roughly €200M in revenue, we have grown consistently across Europe and beyond, and our marketing team combines performance marketing with rigorous data work. What You'll Do - Own marketing tracking quality and measurement reliability across all markets, setting up and auditing GTM, GA4, ad platform pixels, server-side tracking, conversion APIs, UTMs, and event taxonomy for clean, GDPR-compliant data across Google, Meta, TikTok, affiliates, and CRM. - Design, build, and automate dashboards in tools such as Looker and AI-assisted reporting workflows that explain what is happening, why, and what action to take, and own the metric definitions that make them the single source of truth. - Design and run structured incrementality tests, including geo-lift tests, holdout tests, and pre/post analyses, to measure the true marginal impact of media spend, promotions, channels, and campaigns. - Partner with the Marketing Operations Lead and Head of Marketing to define budget allocation frameworks across Google, Meta, SEO, affiliates, and email, and translate data on traffic, cohorts, funnels, and creative performance into clear growth recommendations for country managers and leadership. - Set analytics standards, documentation, and best practices, support and improve our MCP and data connector ecosystem, and challenge misleading metrics so decisions rest on sound data. What You'll Bring - 3+ years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Web Analytics, or Growth Analytics, ideally within D2C e-commerce, with hands-on knowledge of GTM, GA4, e-commerce data layers, pixels, server-side tracking, UTMs, and conversion APIs. - High proficiency in SQL and experience working with cloud data warehouses and multiple marketing, CRM, and e-commerce data sources. - Solid understanding of attribution, incrementality, cohort analysis, funnel analysis, CAC, ROAS, MER, contribution margin, and payback. - A strong statistical mindset with practical experience designing A/B tests, geo-lift tests, holdout tests, or conversion lift studies, and the communication skills to turn analytical topics into clear guidance for marketing and leadership. - Bonus: experience with AI-assisted analytics, API connectors, automated reporting, or marketing data infrastructure. What we offer 💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid 🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take real ownership from the start with direct impact on key business outcomes, work with an international team across Europe, and follow fast-track opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles as PERGOLUX scales. ⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year of remote workation in the EU/UK 🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle - Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows) - Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products - Jobrad / Bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting - Regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats 📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin (easily accessible by public transport) How to Apply Ready to build the analytics backbone of a growing premium e-commerce brand? Apply through our Career Page or reach out via LinkedIn . We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you. PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. title: Data Analist
description: Zie jij snel welke data nodig is om een businessvraag te beantwoorden? Als Data Analist binnen het Data & AI Office analyseer je data, vertaal je vraagstukken uit de business naar concrete inzichten en help je collega’s om die inzichten te gebruiken voor betere beslissingen. Ook onderzoek je waar AI waarde kan toevoegen en werk je mee aan praktische toepassingen die de manier van werken verbeteren. Je bent de schakel tussen de business en de specialisten binnen Data & AI. Daarmee zorg je ervoor dat goede ideeën niet blijven hangen in analyses of experimenten, maar leiden tot oplossingen die medewerkers daadwerkelijk gebruiken en die waarde opleveren voor onze leden. Wie ben jij Jij bent analytisch sterk en oprecht nieuwsgierig naar wat er binnen de business speelt. Je neemt geen genoegen met de eerste vraag, maar onderzoekt welk probleem er werkelijk moet worden opgelost en welke informatie nodig is om een goede beslissing te nemen. Je kunt schakelen tussen verschillende werelden. Je begrijpt de taal van de business, werkt zelf ook graag met data en kan goed samenwerken met technische dataspecialisten. Je hoeft niet zelf ieder model of datapipeline te bouwen, maar je begrijpt voldoende van data en AI om mogelijkheden te herkennen, inhoudelijke vragen te stellen en resultaten kritisch te beoordelen. Je communiceert helder en overtuigend. Je kunt complexe analyses eenvoudig uitleggen en helpt collega’s om inzichten en AI-oplossingen op een goede manier toe te passen. Daarbij ben je organisatiesensitief, verbindend en resultaatgericht. Je neemt eigenaarschap en blijft betrokken totdat een oplossing daadwerkelijk wordt gebruikt en waarde toevoegt. Wat neem je mee? hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een opleiding in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Econometrie, Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde of een vergelijkbare richting; meerdere jaren relevante ervaring als data-analist, businessanalist of in een vergelijkbare rol; ervaring met het vertalen van businessvragen naar analyses, informatieproducten of datatoepassingen; goede kennis van data-analyse en ervaring met SQL en Snowflake; het vermogen om analyses te vertalen naar duidelijke adviezen en concrete verbeteracties; affiniteit met artificial intelligence en de nieuwsgierigheid om nieuwe toepassingen snel eigen te maken; ervaring met het begeleiden van stakeholders en stimuleren van adoptie; oog voor datakwaliteit, privacy en verantwoord gebruik van data en AI; sterke communicatieve en samenwerkingsvaardigheden; uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Wat ga je doen Je werkt vanuit het Data & AI Office binnen één of meerdere waardestromen van Univé. Je kent de doelstellingen, processen en uitdagingen van de waardestroom en onderzoekt samen met collega’s waar data en AI kunnen bijdragen aan betere dienstverlening, efficiëntere processen en onderbouwde besluitvorming. Je helpt de business om de juiste vragen te stellen. Je brengt informatiebehoeften in kaart, analyseert beschikbare data en vertaalt uitkomsten naar heldere inzichten en concrete aanbevelingen. Je onderzoekt ook waar voorspellende modellen, generatieve AI of andere slimme toepassingen medewerkers kunnen ondersteunen in hun dagelijkse werk. Je werkt intensief samen met collega’s uit de business, Business Informatie Analisten, data scientists, data engineers en andere specialisten binnen het Data & AI Office. Je verbindt de inhoudelijke kennis van de waardestroom met de mogelijkheden van data en AI. Tijdens de ontwikkeling bewaak je het doel en de toegevoegde waarde. Na oplevering help je de business om de oplossing te begrijpen, te gebruiken en verder te verbeteren. Concreet houd je je bezig met: ophalen en doorgronden van businessvragen binnen de waardestroom; herkennen en concretiseren van kansen voor data, analytics en AI; analyseren van data met SQL in Snowflake en Python en vertalen van de uitkomsten naar begrijpelijke inzichten en adviezen; ontwikkelen en verbeteren van rapportages, dashboards en andere informatieproducten; samen met data scientists en data engineers werken aan dataproducten en AI-toepassingen; formuleren van heldere requirements, use cases en acceptatiecriteria; ondersteunen van medewerkers en leidinggevenden bij het begrijpen en toepassen van data en AI; stimuleren van adoptie en datagedreven werken binnen de waardestroom; bewaken of een oplossing daadwerkelijk bijdraagt aan het oorspronkelijke businessdoel; signaleren van problemen rondom datakwaliteit, definities en beschikbaarheid; verantwoord omgaan met data en AI, met aandacht voor privacy, uitlegbaarheid en menselijke controle; delen van kennis, voorbeelden en succesvolle toepassingen binnen Univé. Je standplaats is Zwolle, maar we werken ook een dag in Assen. We werken hybride, waarbij je gemiddeld de helft van de tijd op kantoor werkt. Wat bieden wij Binnen het Data & AI Office krijg je een veelzijdige functie waarin je direct samenwerkt met de business en zichtbaar bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van Univé. Je krijgt de ruimte om kansen te signaleren, collega’s mee te nemen en ideeën om te zetten in toepassingen die in de praktijk waarde opleveren. Salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden: deze functie is ingedeeld in schaal 9. Het jaarsalaris ligt tussen € 58.352 tot € 82.378 op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning; Uitdagende projecten: je werkt aan organisatiebrede afwisselende vraagstukken op het snijvlak van data, AI, technologie en business; Ontwikkeling: we investeren in jouw persoonlijke en professionele groei met opleidingen, kennisdeling en ruimte om je verder te specialiseren; Ruimte voor initiatief: je krijgt de vrijheid om kansen te onderzoeken, voorstellen te doen en verbeteringen in gang te zetten; Moderne werkomgeving: je werkt met SQL in Snowflake. Voor complexere analyses gebruik je Python. Daarnaast maak je gebruik van ChatGPT en andere moderne data- en AI-toepassingen; Innovatie en autonomie: je krijgt ruimte om nieuwe technieken te onderzoeken en eigen ideeën te ontwikkelen, testen en verbeteren; Hybride werken: je werkt gemiddeld 50% op kantoor en 50% vanuit huis, inclusief ondersteuning voor je thuiswerkplek; Extra voordelen: korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé. Wie wij zijn Binnen het Data & AI Office werken we aan de data- en AI-ambitie van heel Univé. We ontwikkelen het centrale datafundament, bouwen betrouwbare dataproducten en zetten data en AI in om besluitvorming, processen en klantbediening te verbeteren. Je komt terecht in een omgeving met data scientists, data engineers, data-analisten, business informatie analisten en andere dataspecialisten. Samen met collega’s uit de waardestromen en bedrijfsonderdelen brengen we kennis van data, technologie en de business bij elkaar. We geloven in eigenaarschap, vakmanschap en samenwerking. We experimenteren graag, maar zorgen er ook voor dat succesvolle oplossingen veilig, betrouwbaar en beheersbaar in productie worden genomen. Zo maken we data en AI praktisch toepasbaar voor onze medewerkers en betekenisvol voor onze leden. Overige informatie Enthousiast? Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatiebutton. title: Senior Carrier and Product Management
description: Die Position Du verbindest Cyberversicherung, Produktentwicklung und Carrier-Steuerung. In dieser Schlüsselrolle verantwortest du das Versicherungsportfolio und die MGA-Partnerschaften von Eye Security und entwickelst skalierbare Lösungen für unsere europäischen Märkte Deine Aufgaben Produktmanagement Du entwickelst unsere Cyber-Versicherungsprodukte in Deutschland, den Niederlanden, Österreich und weiteren Ländern weiter und verknüpfst sie eng mit unserem Cyber-Guard- und Incident-Response-Angebot. Bei Bedarf koordinierst du externe Partner. Du verfolgst Markt-, Carrier- und Brokertrends und passt Produkte sowie Bedingungswerke gezielt an. Du unterstützt das Underwriting-Team und unsere Kunden bei rechtlichen und versicherungstechnischen Fragen. Du erkennst Compliance-Risiken in allen Märkten frühzeitig und setzt rechtskonforme Lösungen für die jeweilige Rechtsordnung um. Du treibst die Einführung eines modularen Produktkonzepts voran und skalierst Abläufe durch Automatisierung. Carrier Management Du steuerst das Carrier Management rechtlich und strategisch. Du verhandelst und verantwortest den Abschluss von Assekuradeurverträgen in der EU und im Vereinigten Königreich und steuerst Kapazitäten für KMU und Großrisiken. Du baust eine stabile, langfristige und diversifizierte Carrier-Basis auf, die unserem Geschäftsmodell bestmöglich entspricht. Du verantwortest alle MGA-Verträge, koordinierst Verlängerungen und baust ein Claims-Management auf, das unsere Profitabilitätsziele mit den Anforderungen der Carrier verbindet. Dein Profil Du verfügst über fundiertes juristisches Wissen im Bereich Cyber-Versicherung in Deutschland, den Niederlanden oder einem anderen EU-Land. Eine juristische Qualifikation als Rechtsanwalt beziehungsweise vergleichbare juristische Expertise ist ein Plus. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Cyber-Produkten und Bedingungswerken aus dem Underwriting und/oder der Schadenabwicklung mit. Du verstehst Cyber-Compliance und regulatorische Anforderungen und hast praktische Erfahrung mit Incident-Response- und Präventionslösungen. Du denkst unternehmerisch, arbeitest strukturiert und detailorientiert und möchtest etwas aufbauen und skalieren. Du arbeitest selbstständig, trittst sicher auf und bist verlässlich. Es gelingt dir, andere mitzunehmen. Du verhandelst souverän mit Kunden und Partnern, bist belastbar und übernimmst Verantwortung. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch sowie auf Deutsch oder Niederländisch. Das bieten wir dir Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Cybersecurity-Scale-ups Europas. Die Möglichkeit, eine innovative Cybersecurity-Produktlinie mitzugestalten, die wirksame Cybersicherheit und Cyber-Versicherung global verbindet. Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive Bonus. Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. Car Allowance. Wahlfreiheit bei deiner Ausstattung: MacBook oder Dell Laptop sowie iPhone oder Android-Smartphone. Aktive Unterstützung deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung. Die Zusammenarbeit mit erstklassigen Cybersecurity-Expert:innen in unserem internationalen CERT-Team. Über Eye Security Eye Security bietet Unternehmen in Europa Cybersicherheit mit integrierten Cyberversicherungslösungen. Unser Team vereint Fachleute mit Erfahrung in den Bereichen Nachrichtendienst, Militär, Technologie und Beratung. Sie alle verbindet eine gemeinsame Mission: Cybersicherheit auf Enterprise-Niveau für jedes Unternehmen zugänglich zu machen – nicht nur für die Großen. Eye Security wurde 2020 in Den Haag gegründet und vereint Managed Detection and Response, ein rund um die Uhr von Menschen betriebenes Security Operations Center (SOC), schnelle Incident Response und eine eigene Cyberversicherung auf einer einzigen Plattform. Das Unternehmen betreut Organisationen in den Niederlanden, Belgien und Deutschland und baut seine Plattform sowie den Marktzugang in ganz Europa aus. Eye Security wird von Bessemer Venture Partners, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners und TIN Capital unterstützt. Zuletzt nahm das Unternehmen in einer von Sofina angeführten Series-C-Finanzierungsrunde 60 Millionen Euro auf. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior SOC Analyst
description: Scope of Impact Actively participates with other seniors in SOC activities by providing knowledge and insight on more complex client cases. Provides ideas and concrete input for process and efficiency improvements. Actively participates in overall team- and workflow-improvement projects. Expertise In-depth knowledge of the operational use of security monitoring tools (SIEM, EDR). Ability to assess complex logs, recognise patterns, and derive actionable insights. Actively develops both technical and soft skills, and stays current with changes in the field. A credible voice and source of knowledge in the department. Autonomy and Contribution Style Full autonomy during complex SOC escalations. Skills and confidence to coordinate the team’s response. Collaborates with, and gives guidance to, the team on arising issues. Once fully onboarded, demonstrates the ability to handle Tier 3 shifts. Complexity High complexity: oversees entire projects and influences cross-functional teams; decisions impact the department and adjacent areas. Responsibilities Monitor security alerts and perform initial triage; classify (false positive, true positive, uncertain) and close out confirmed false positives correctly Take full ownership of escalated and the most complex alerts: root-cause analysis, log correlation, validating assessments, determining next steps Own client communication for assigned alerts, including difficult or high-risk escalations from more junior analysts, to a consistent quality standard Independently execute containment actions across impact levels; approve escalations from more junior analysts Own the team’s overall workload and service-level adherence day to day; pull in support or escalate when targets are at risk Answer cross-department questions on security operations; improve documentation and working instructions for junior levels Mentor junior and mid-level colleagues Identify patterns across multiple cases and escalations that point to systemic detection gaps or false-positive sources, and turn them into structured input for the detection content owners — not one-off flags Contribute to team projects and process/efficiency improvements Not in scope at this level, or ever, on this track Incident response casework — a separate specialisation Detection rule ownership, detection engineering, and threat hunting — owned by a separate team Requirements 4+ years hands-on SOC/security operations experience Proven ability to own and drive the team’s SLA/workload independently Strong client communication in high-risk situations Track record mentoring junior colleagues Solid log analysis and EDR platform experience; familiarity with major cloud platforms Language fluency matching the client base supported; English internally; Dutch and/or German required or strongly preferred depending on client-facing exposure Growth path From here, the role forks: an individual-contributor track (Staff-level, then an optional cross-functional Principal role), or a people-leadership track (Team Lead). About Eye Security Eye Security provides cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organisations across Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, 200+ FTEs and growing internationally. We combine 24/7 detection and response with hands-on incident response to keep SMEs protected. title: Langfuse - Senior Software Engineer, SDK
description: Why SDK Engineering at Langfuse Your work will have an outsized impact. Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month. When you ship a new integration or improve SDK performance, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. The SDK is often the very first thing a developer touches when they try Langfuse, so your work directly shapes their first impression. You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM-applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers in the world and that leverage Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible SDK experience and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. You will grow at Langfuse by Owning our SDKs . We maintain SDKs in Python and TypeScript both built on OpenTelemetry. You'll be responsible for their reliability, performance, and developer experience. These SDKs run inside our users' production systems, which means they must never fail, must have minimal impact on CPU and memory, and must work flawlessly across every environment — from serverless functions to long-running agent loops. You'll think deeply about the exposed interfaces, error handling, batching, async flushing, and graceful degradation. Designing APIs that developers love . How are functions named, how are parameters structured, how are breaking changes communicated, how does the documentation read? Developer experience is a core differentiator for Langfuse and you'll own every detail of it. When we shipped the Python SDK v3 and TypeScript SDK v4 , both were full rewrites on OpenTelemetry — that's the kind of thoughtful, high-impact SDK work you'll lead. Apart from tracing, we also support core workflows of engineers building with LLMs with our SDKs, see our Experiment Runner SDK for example. Integrating with every major AI framework : Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You'll maintain these integrations, ensure new Langfuse features are supported across all of them, and add new integrations as the ecosystem evolves. When a new framework gains traction, you'll be among the first to instrument it. Maintaining our OpenTelemetry endpoint : some users send traces directly to our OTLP endpoint instead of using our SDKs. You'll ensure this path is robust, well-documented, and supports the full range of Langfuse features. This also extends our language support to Java, Go, and any language with an OpenTelemetry SDK. You can work with the OpenTelemetry community to steer the GenAI conventions. Writing public documentation : you'll own the SDK docs, integration guides, and migration paths. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new SDK version or integration, the docs ship with it. What we're looking for Strong engineer who gets excited about developer experience, API design, and writing code that runs reliably in other people's production systems Experience building or maintaining SDKs, client libraries, or developer tools — ideally in Python and/or TypeScript Deep understanding of performance: you know how to profile, benchmark, and minimize CPU/memory overhead in hot paths Someone who can manage projects themselves — you know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it Thoughtful about versioning, backwards compatibility, and migration paths Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their integration challenges Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters CS or quantitative degree preferred Bonus points: Experience with OpenTelemetry internals or observability instrumentation Former founder or early startup experience Contributions to popular open source SDKs or developer tools ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem No candidate checks all boxes.
