title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description: Wat ga je doen? Samen met de CEO en COO werk je aan de verdere strategische en financiële ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Als CFO vertaal je de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete groeikansen door schaalbare verdien- en prijsmodellen te ontwikkelen. Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen. Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Daarbij weeg je beschikbare financieringsopties zorgvuldig af op impact, liquiditeit en rendement. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Met heldere go/no-go-momenten per fase zorg je ervoor dat de ontwikkeling en implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen niet sneller gaat dan wat de organisatie kan adopteren. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Tegelijkertijd borg je dat contracten allesomvattende afspraken en een evenwichtige risicoverdeling bevatten, evenals uitvoerbaar zijn in alle landen waar Voortman Steel Machinery actief is. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn. Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Tevens bewaak je per land en internationale entiteit het rendement, de cashflow, het werkkapitaal en houd je zicht op financiële, juridische, fiscale, contractuele en compliance-risico’s. Ook de financiële besturing en beheersing van Voortman Steel Machinery valt onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent internationaal eindverantwoordelijk voor consolidatie, planning & control, reporting, accounting, treasury, audit, tax, vennootschapsbelasting en interne beheersing. Aansluitend zie je toe op het opstellen van correcte en transparante rapportages per internationale entiteit. De dagelijkse coördinatie van deze verschillende activiteiten en de aansturing van de Finance-afdeling wordt verzorgd door de Finance-director, waarmee je nauw samenwerkt. Jij fungeert als sparringpartner, stuurt bij waar nodig, bewaakt de strategisch richting van de Finance-afdeling, verzorgt correcte governance en behandeld onderwerpen met board impact. Tevens ben je het gezicht van Voortman Steel Machinery richting banken, verzekeraars, accountant en andere financiële stakeholders. Wat maakt deze rol uniek? In deze rol krijg je de kans om zichtbaar richting te geven aan de volgende groeifase van Voortman Steel Machinery. Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en slagkracht samenkomen: ideeën worden niet alleen verkend, maar ook scherp getoetst op waardecreatie, rendement, risico en schaalbaarheid. Daarmee krijg je ruimte om jouw financiële expertise en strategisch vermogen in te zetten bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe proposities, het onderbouwen van businesscases en het bepalen van investeringskeuzes die impact hebben op de internationale groei van de organisatie. Dit maakt de functie nadrukkelijk méér dan een traditionele CFO-rol: je bewaakt niet alleen de financiële basis, maar bent medebepalend in hoe Voortman Steel Machinery commerciële kansen vertaalt naar gezonde, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige groei. Positie binnen de organisatie Voortman Steel Machinery ontwikkelt machines, software en serviceoplossingen waarmee staalverwerkende bedrijven hun productieprocessen automatiseren en optimaliseren. Het hoofdkantoor is gevestigd in Nederland. Dankzij vestigingen in verschillende landen kan effectieve lokale ondersteuning worden geboden. De recent geopende, grootschalige productielocatie in de Verenigde Staten laat zien hoe de organisatie internationaal blijft groeien. Tevens vindt in Engeland hoofdzakelijk de ontwikkeling van onze LogicSteel-software plaats. Daarnaast bezit Voortman wereldwijd diverse sales & service-hubs. Als CFO vorm je samen met de CEO en COO de board van Voortman Steel Machinery, geef je met hen richting aan de ontwikkeling van het Global Management Team en de organisatie als geheel. Jouw focus ligt op het vertalen van de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete kansen voor nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met de afdeling Product Management, dat verantwoordelijk is voor het identificeren en ontwikkelen van software-, machine- en serviceproposities. Als CFO ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de Finance-afdeling en werk je nauw samen met de Finance Director, die de dagelijkse internationale operationele aansturing van de afdeling verzorgt. Tevens rapporteren de HR-Manager en Trade Compliance Officer aan jou. De HR-Manager is (mede) verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van de HR-strategie en het borgen van de operationele uitvoering. Daarnaast ziet de Trade Compliance Officer erop toe dat de organisatie voldoet aan de relevante wet- en regelgeving. Daarbij bewaakt de Trade Compliance Officer onder andere de inhoudelijke juistheid en werking van ingezette maatregelen. Wat wij bieden? Bij Voortman Steel Machinery kom je terecht in een écht familiebedrijf met een informele, betrokken en ondernemende cultuur. Mensen kennen elkaar en lijnen zijn kort. Er is volop ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, initiatief te tonen en ideeën verder te brengen. Onze kernwaarden ondernemerschap, vakmanschap, passie voor technologie, toewijding en samenwerking vormen daarbij de basis voor hoe we werken en met elkaar omgaan. Je ziet ze terug in de trots waarmee we hoogwaardige technologie ontwikkelen, in de manier waarop teams elkaar versterken en in de gezamenlijke drive om klanten vooruit te helpen. Zo ontstaat een werkomgeving waarin ambitie, betrokkenheid en werkplezier op een natuurlijke manier samenkomen. Naast een professionele, ondernemende en loyale werkomgeving krijg je bij ons: Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring; Een passende pensioenregeling bij ASR, waarbij jij en Voortman samen pensioenkapitaal opbouwen; Een leaseauto voor zakelijk en privégebruik; Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze strategie met internationale impact; Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen; Wat breng je mee? Wij zoeken een ondernemende, strategische en daadkrachtige CFO met een afgeronde masteropleiding in Finance, Economie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting. Een titel als RA, RC of CPA is een must. Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als CFO, Divisie-CFO, Senior Finance Director, Head of Finance of Director Corporate Finance, bij voorkeur binnen een internationale original equipment manufacturer (OEM), industrieel technologiebedrijf, technisch complexe B2B-organisatie of top-tier consultancybureau. Ervaring binnen een ondernemend familiebedrijf of een organisatie van vergelijkbare omvang en complexiteit is daarbij een pré. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met aansturen van een finance-afdeling of -team. Verder voldoe je aan het volgende profiel: Strategisch en analytisch vermogen: je beschikt over sterk analytisch en strategisch vermogen en hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het doorgronden van complexe data en businessmodellen. Je weet informatie te vertalen naar heldere strategische en financiële logica, logische transparante aannames en goed onderbouwde besluitvorming. Je bent in staat om richting te bepalen, langetermijndoelen te formuleren en de organisatie daarin mee te nemen. Businessmodelinnovatie: je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het in kaart brengen van groeikansen en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe (schaalbare) verdien-, prijs- en contractmodellen. Deze weet je te onderbouwen met solide businesscases en scenarioanalyses. Daarnaast heb je ruime ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financieringsmodellen en het inrichten van kapitaalallocatie op basis van het (verwachte) rendement, risico’s en strategische bijdrage. Besluitvaardig en resultaatgericht: je bent besluitvaardig en kunt tijdig en doordacht keuzes maken op basis van beschikbare informatie. Als je éénmaal een keuze hebt gemaakt, durf je achter je keuze te blijven staan. Je beschikt over overtuigingskracht, kunt draagvlak creëren en interne en externe stakeholders zorgvuldig meenemen in strategische veranderingen. Tevens stuur je actief op concrete resultaten en realiseer je aantoonbare positieve financiële impact. Verandervermogen en omgevingsbewustzijn: je hebt ervaring met het realiseren van interne veranderingen en de implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen, evenals het tijdig bijsturen daarvan. Tevens ben je sterk in het vertalen van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen naar heldere, beheersbare processen en rollen. Daarbij zorg je voor een gestructureerde stapsgewijze implementatie en ben je sterk in het meenemen en begeleiden van collega’s tijdens veranderingen. Ook onder druk en in complexe situaties blijf je rustig, behoud je overzicht en kun je snel schakelen. Tevens heb je een scherp oog voor verhoudingen, kun je belangen goed afwegen en anticipeer je tijdig op ontwikkelingen. Daarbij heb je een goed begrip van culturele en organisatorische verschillen in een internationale context. Verbindend vermogen en communicatie: je bent betrokken en weet duurzame professionele relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden met interne en externe stakeholders, zoals banken, accountants en verzekeraars. Je communiceert helder, informeert betrokkenen tijdig over relevante ontwikkelingen en bent benaderbaar. Je weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk over te brengen en stemt je communicatie af op verschillende gesprekspartners. Daarnaast beschik je over sterke Nederlandse en Engelse communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Inspirerend leiderschap: jouw leiderschap is gericht op groei, vertrouwen en ontwikkeling. Je weet medewerkers te coachen, te inspireren en richting te geven, terwijl je ruimte geeft voor eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid. Daarbij stuur je bij waar nodig, stimuleer je samenwerking en help je collega’s hun potentieel te benutten. Zo draag je bij aan een omgeving waarin mensen zich betrokken voelen en werken aan gezamenlijke doelen. Onafhankelijke en reflectieve houding: je hebt een onafhankelijke, kritische en constructieve houding, staat open voor feedback, kunt je eigen handelen kritisch evalueren en wilt continu blijven leren. Nieuwsgierig? Ben jij dé ondernemende en daadkrachtige Chief Financial Officer (CFO) die strategie weet te vertalen naar waarde, nieuwe verdienmodellen tot leven brengt, internationale groei mede realiseert en de organisatie met visie en resultaatgerichtheid stuurt? title: Werkstudent Recruiting (Fitness Trainer) (m/w/d)
description: Über LIFTED Mit LIFTED bauen wir die neue Go-to-Marke für Krafttraining auf. In einer Welt voller Longevity Quick Fixes und exklusiver Fitness-Trends konzentrieren wir uns auf einen der wichtigsten Faktoren für ein langes und gesundes Leben: Krafttraining. Unsere Studios machen Krafttraining einfach, effektiv und messbar – für Menschen, die stärker werden wollen, sich in klassischen Fitnessstudios aber nicht zuhause fühlen. Der Trainingsfortschritt wird digital erfasst, während unsere Trainer jedes Mitglied individuell unterstützen und für ein motivierendes Trainingserlebnis sorgen. Hinter LIFTED steht ein erfahrenes Founding Team mit tiefem Know-how in der Fitnessbranche & dem Aufbau von Offline Operations. Gemeinsam haben wir BEAT81 von Grund auf aufgebaut und auf 35 Standorte skaliert. Jetzt entwickeln wir Krafttraining mit LIFTED neu – und bauen die nächste große Fitnessmarke auf. In den vergangenen 18 Monaten haben wir 6 Studios in Berlin eröffnet. Bis Ende 2026 werden wir neun Standorte betreiben. Ab 2027 planen wir, jährlich mehr als 12 neue Studios in deutschen Großstädten zu eröffnen. Um dieses Konzept weiter auszubauen, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Recruiting (Fitness Trainer) (m/w/d). Über die Rolle Unsere TrainerInnen sind das Herz von LIFTED. Sie bringen unseren KundInnnen die Grundlagen des Krafttrainings bei, helfen ihnen dabei Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und bieten ein einzigartiges Trainingserlebnis. Und genau die Menschen, die das möglich machen, suchen wir. Als Werkstudent im Trainer Recruiting spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Wachstum von LIFTED. Du findest talentierte TrainerInnen, begeisterst sie für uns und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Tryout im Studio. Mit jedem neuen Studio wächst unser Team – und du gestaltest aktiv mit, wer Teil davon wird. Aufgaben Active Sourcing Du findest passende Trainer:innen in ganz Deutschland über Instagram, LinkedIn und andere Kanäle , sprichst sie direkt an und machst sie neugierig auf LIFTED. Screening Du sichtest eingehende Bewerbungen, schätzt ein, wer zu uns passt , und hältst den Überblick über alle Kandidat:innen im Prozess. Erstgespräche Du führst die ersten Interviews , lernst die Kandidat:innen kennen und stellst LIFTED vor. Tryouts organisieren Bevor wir TrainerInnen einstellen, laden wir sie zu einem Tryout ins Studio ein. So lernen wir sie kennen und sehen sie in Action. title: Senior Systems Engineer, MCP Server Portals
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal </strong></p> <h2>Role Summary</h2> <p>Cloudflare MCP Server Portals give organizations a secure, centralized way to connect AI agents to internal and third-party tools. As a Senior Systems Engineer on the MCP Portals team, you will lead the design, delivery, and operation of distributed systems that authenticate users, manage OAuth credentials and sessions, enforce Zero Trust policies, and proxy MCP traffic across Cloudflare's global network. You will own complex projects across service boundaries, make architectural tradeoffs for your area, and help other engineers deliver reliable, secure changes. You will work closely with engineers and product managers across Access, Gateway, and Developer Platform teams as the protocol and product evolve. We are looking for a hands-on engineer who can bring clarity to ambiguous systems problems and take responsibility for outcomes in production.</p> <h4> </h4> <h2>Role Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead the design, implementation, and operation of globally distributed services that connect MCP clients to authorized upstream MCP servers.</li> <li>Own complex features and service improvements from problem definition and design through implementation, rollout, observability, and production support.</li> <li>Shape technical decisions for MCP Portals, including service boundaries, security controls, compatibility, and tradeoffs among reliability, latency, and resource use.</li> <li>Evolve our implementation as the MCP specification changes, planning safe migrations for existing customers and integrations.</li> <li>Design and review authentication and authorization flows involving Cloudflare Access, OAuth, identity, credential handling, and delegated access to upstream services.</li> <li>Improve the reliability and scalability of multi-tenant systems built on the Cloudflare Developer Platform, using production data to identify and prioritize work.</li> <li>Strengthen observability through structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts; participate in production support and incident response.</li> <li>Lead investigations of complex customer issues across services and teams, identify root causes, and drive fixes that prevent recurrence.</li> <li>Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and raise the quality of testing, deployment, and operational practices on the team.</li> <li>Partner with product, security, and engineering teams to turn customer needs and emerging standards into maintainable product capabilities.</li> </ul> <h4> </h4> <h2>Role Requirements</h2> <h3>Must Have Skills</h3> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience building and operating distributed systems, backend services, network services, or infrastructure products in production.</li> <li>Demonstrated ownership of complex production services or projects, including architecture, implementation, rollout, and operational outcomes.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, C++, or another language used to build production services.</li> <li>Deep understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, streaming connections, and distributed-systems failure modes.</li> <li>Experience with authentication and authorization technologies such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWTs, PKCE, or policy-based access control.</li> <li>Experience designing or operating security-sensitive systems, with sound judgment about identity, authorization, credential handling, concurrency, and state management.</li> <li>Ability to diagnose difficult production issues using logs, metrics, traces, error reporting, and customer-provided evidence, then drive durable fixes.</li> <li>Experience making backward-compatible changes to live systems and managing the risks of deployment and migration.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs, influence decisions across teams, and mentor other engineers.</li> </ul> <p>Applicants should provide a resume or CV describing relevant engineering, technical leadership, and operational experience.</p> <h3>Nice to Have Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with the Model Context Protocol </li> <li>Familiarity with the Cloudflare Developer Platform or other serverless edge-computing platforms.</li> <li>Experience building gateways, forward proxies, identity systems, developer platforms, or Zero Trust and data loss prevention products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66,000-91,000 </span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Coordonner les lancements, promotions et engagements clients avec les équipes marketing, ADV, logistique, R&D et production. Anticiper les besoins des clients et assurer la bonne exécution des engagements commerciaux. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques et contribuer à la structuration de notre développement. title: Customer Experience Manager - French and Spanish or Portuguese Speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location: Lisbon, Portugal</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Experience Manager leads the post-sale customer journey, managing everything from onboarding to long-term retention and contract renewals. You will collaborate tightly with the Sales team to maintain accurate weekly forecasts and contribute to  critical engagements like Executive Business Reviews. In addition, you will embed AI-driven optimization into your daily workflows—using advanced data analysis to uncover selling opportunities and automating routine tasks to accelerate customer outcomes and maximize operational efficiency.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <h3>Customer Lifecycle & Success</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Manage customer engagement across the entire customer lifecycle, from onboarding through renewal.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be a Trusted Advisor to your customers by helping them adopt the Cloudflare products and services to meet their needs and make them successful</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with your account teams to plan and execute long term Success Plans with our largest customers to facilitate retention and growth via product and new business unit expansion.</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain a deep understanding of our solutions and present to customers about the most relevant features/functionality for their specific business needs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own or be an active participant in several customer touch points including: Business Value Justification meetings, Business Reviews, and Renewal Meetings, with a track record of successful planning and execution of Executive Business Reviews.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrate how your customer engagement directly impacts revenue growth and adoption of Cloudflare solutions and services.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Commercial & Renewals</h3> <ul> <li> <p>You are ultimately responsible for the retention and growth of your book of business. You will own and drive the renewal including maintaining and reporting an accurate weekly forecast.</p> </li> <li> <p>Negotiate and execute renewal contracts in accordance with customer objectives.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will be an expert in deal construction and pricing strategy. You will directly be designing renewals to create a win-win for customers and Cloudflare. </p> </li> <li> <p>Analyze data and leverage tools to identify selling opportunities and business value.</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive strong alignment with the Sales team, contributing to team forecasting, planning, and targets.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Cross-Functional & Operational Management</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Develop and maintain long-term relationships with stakeholders in your account portfolio.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support,Marketing and other teams to resolve customer business issues and work towards each customer’s stated goals.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage customer feedback and product needs by providing feature requests to internal partner teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Able to prioritize effectively to handle multiple deals at the same time.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>AI Competencies</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Generative AI: Mastery of LLMs to rapidly draft renewal communications, synthesize quarterly review data, and prepare executive summaries.</p> </li> <li> <p>Data Analysis: Proficiency in leveraging AI analytics tools to parse customer usage metrics and instantly highlight up-sell or cross-sell opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Workflow Automation: Ability to build automations to synchronize CRM data, update weekly forecasts, and trigger lifecycle alerts.</p> </li> <li> <p>AI Problem Solving: The instinct to view AI as a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Customer Success/Account Management role or Inside or Field sales.</p> </li> <li>Fluency in French AND Spanish or Portuguese</li> <li> <p>2+ years of industry experience, with experience in cloud security and/or performance industries preferred.</p> </li> <li> <p>Bachelor's degree and/or other professional qualifications.</p> </li> <li> <p>Direct experience in commercial sales, negotiation, and deal closure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of or willingness to learn about computer networking and “how the internet works,” with network security a plus.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage and prioritize competing portfolio demands, aligning internal resources with the highest-impact commercial and retention goals</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise in SaaS retention and sales process and excellent knowledge of value driven sales.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent problem solving skills with the ability to creatively achieve resolutions.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="2">● For title: Senior Backend Engineer, VGo Carrier Technology
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>As Senior Backend Engineer in the Vinted Go Carrier domain, you will build backend systems that move parcels through Vinted Go's own logistics network, between hubs and through warehouses, quickly, reliably and at scale.</p> <p>You'll join Vinted Go, the logistics arm of Vinted, focused on making shipping more affordable, convenient, and reliable. Your team, <strong>Pacman</strong>, owns mid-mile logistics and warehouse operations automation: how parcels are routed and transported between hubs, and how they are received, labelled, and dispatched.</p> <p>We're looking for a strong engineer who also makes the engineers around them better: someone who leads the team's hardest technical problems and actively shares what they know, so the whole team grows with them.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that power mid-mile transport and warehouse operations.</li> <li>Own technical initiatives end to end, from problem framing and system design through delivery, monitoring, and iteration, and lead projects that span the team or the wider domain.</li> <li>Make architecture and trade-off decisions with a 6–12 month horizon, balancing scalability, reliability, maintainability, and tech debt.</li> <li>Help evolve our core service, a large Ruby on Rails modular monolith, towards clearer module boundaries and well-defined APIs.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Operations, Decision Science, and neighboring engineering teams to shape discovery, sequencing, and implementation, and align on contracts and dependencies through RFCs and technical discussions.</li> <li>Actively share knowledge: give thoughtful code reviews, pair on hard problems, walk the team through complex changes, and keep documentation useful.</li> <li>Help onboard new team members, mentor engineers informally, and trust others with meaningful work while supporting them to succeed.</li> <li>Work with a backend stack that includes Ruby, Vitess, Kafka, Jenkins, Elastic, and observability tools; description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold: </p> <ol> <li><strong>Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency</strong>: we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.</li> <li><strong>Drive strategic engineering initiatives</strong>: architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web. </li> </ol> <p>You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.</p> <p>You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you will</strong></h2> <p><strong>Strategically:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace.</strong> We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job</li> <li><strong>Drive Technology Strategy:</strong> Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit. </li> <li><strong>Refine the domain's identity: </strong>Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tactically</strong>: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead frontends:</strong> Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead Initiatives:</strong> Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.</li> <li><strong>Elevate global UI quality:</strong> Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.</li> <li><strong>Ensure Resilience & Reliability:</strong> Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.</li> <li><strong>Innovate & Optimize:</strong> Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend development and explore cross-platform frontend development opportunities to increase engineering speed and productivity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A lot of this work will be influencing without formal authority</strong>: Champion the frontend technical vision among your director peers, influencing the leaders of 9 Product domains to accommodate and prioritize platform-wide changes across 40+ teams.</p> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <p><strong>How much of a technical acumen? </strong>Enough to have in depth conversations with our direct reports. You will have 4 strong technical EMs reporting to you, as well as 3 world-class staff engineers. We don’t think you need to match their technical competencies (that’s a stretch!), but you have to be able to speak their language, understand problems at their essence, and be able to consolidate and multiply their inputs, including being able to disagree objectively.</p> <p><strong>Leadership: </strong>you have a track record of making level change in the organizations that you lead (rather than 20% change). Consolidating your team views and making coherent strategy out of those views is step one. Step two is even more important: being able to implement these changes in your domain, and more so - across other domains in the marketplace - is a foundational ability you carry. In practice, that means you have at least 2 years of experience leading leaders and 5 years of experience influencing without authority. </p> <p><strong>Change horizon:</strong> You are comfortable holding two timeframes at once. Leaders who only do the second are common. Leaders who only do the first are entertaining. We need both.</p> <p><strong>What this role is not:</strong> This is not a hands-on frontend or release-engineering role. You will not be tuning CI, owning the release train, or reviewing architecture decisions yourself — you’ll have 4 strong EMs and 3 Staff Engineers close to the details, and your job is to turn their technical judgment into direction, alignment, and organizational change. If your strongest work is deep in the mechanics, you'll be underused here. If your strongest work is changing how 40+ teams operate, you'll be busy.</p> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>A daily lunch allowance</li> <li>ClassPass (Gym Membership subsidy)</li> <li>Pension plan with total contribution of 12%, 8% by the Company and 4% by employee</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>An NS mobility card</li> <li>The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Individual Learning Budget</strong></p> <p>We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid Work</strong> </p> <p>We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. title: Engineering Manager, Data Center Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the Department</h3><p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p><h3>About the Role</h3><p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p><p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.</p><p>The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.</p><p>This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.</p><h3>What You'll Do</h3><p>Team Leadership</p><ul><li><p>Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.</p></li><li><p>Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.</p></li><li><p>Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.</p></li></ul><p>Site Delivery</p><ul><li><p>Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.</p></li><li><p>Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.</p></li><li><p>Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.</p></li></ul><p>Production Operations</p><ul><li><p>Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.</p></li><li><p>Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.</p></li></ul><p>Documentation and DCIM</p><ul><li><p>Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.</p></li><li><p>Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.</p></li><li><p>Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.</p></li></ul><p>Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle</p><ul><li><p>Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.</p></li><li><p>Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.</p></li></ul><p>Security and Compliance</p><ul><li><p>Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.</p></li><li><p>Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.</p></li><li><p>Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.</p></li></ul><p>Automation and Operational Efficiency</p><ul><li><p>Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.</p></li><li><p>Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.</p></li><li><p>Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.</p></li></ul><p>Business Reporting</p><ul><li><p>Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.</p></li><li><p>Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.</p></li></ul><h3>Who You Are</h3><p><strong>A builder who stays to operate.</strong> You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p><p><strong>A leader of distributed teams.</strong> You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.</p><p><strong>Firm with partners.</strong> You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.</p><p><strong>Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist.</strong> You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.</p><p><strong>Automation-first.</strong> When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.</p><h3>Required Experience</h3><ul><li><p>6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.</p></li><li><p>A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.</p></li><li><p>Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.</p></li><li><p>Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.</p></li><li><p>Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.</p></li><li><p>Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.</p></li><li><p>Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.</p></li><li><p>Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.</p></li><li><p>Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.</p></li><li><p>Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. You should have a track record of keeping documentation accurate from day one, including rack, power, cabling and asset records maintained from hardware arrival through decommissioning.</p></li><li><p>Working knowledge of the security and compliance frameworks common in enterprise-grade data centers. You should understand them well enough to run operations under them; auditor-level expertise isn't required.</p></li><li><p>Strong program management skills across multiple vendors, sites and time-bound workstreams.</p></li><li><p>A track record of reducing toil through tooling or process redesign.</p></li><li><p>Excellent written and verbal communication, including regular business reviews and status, risk and availability reporting to leadership.</p></li><li><p>Ability to travel regularly to data center sites. Expect more frequent travel during site builds, shifting to periodic visits as sites reach steady state.</p></li></ul><h3>Preferred Qualifications</h3

title: Informatikpraktikum E-Commerce im Verlag () (Front/Backend)
description: Wir sind ein erfolgreicher Fachbuch- und Hörmedienverlag im Bereich Alternativ-Medizin mit Sitz in Berlin. Gerade als kleinerer Verlag bieten wir einen umfassenden Einblick in die täglichen Abläufe sämtlicher Bereiche einer dynamisch wachsenden Verlagsarbeit, mit vielseitigen Möglichkeiten zur eigenständigen, aktiven und kreativen Betätigung in einem auch für Anfänger noch überschaubaren IT-System! Unser Firmensitz (Büro) und Ihr Praktikumsplatz befinden sich in mitten Berlin, zentral gelegen im Bezirk Friedrichshain, der bei jungen Menschen sehr beliebt ist. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind ganz in der Nähe, somit ist unser Büro leicht zu erreichen. Möglich bei uns sind 3- bis 6-monatige Pflichtpraktika. Freiwillige Praktika sind aufgrund der engen gesetzlichen Bestimmungen nur ausbildungsbegleitende denkbar, sofern noch keine abgeschlossene Ausbildung vorhanden ist. Bei unserem Praktikum können Sie - je nach Ihren Befähigungen und Neigungen - bei der Entwicklung ein neuen Shopsystems als Entwickler mitwirken. Somit bringen Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen nicht nur - wie bei vielen großen Firmen - in ein kleinteilig fraktioniertes Projekt ein, sondern können umfassend eigenständig tätig werden, mit großem gestalterischen und kreativen Freiraum. Meist sind bei uns noch 2-3 weitere Praktikant*innen aktiv, so dass Sie Teil eines kleinen netten Praktikantenteams sind, das sich auch gegenseitig unterstützen kann. Ausländische Bewerber sind willkommen. Foreign applicants are very welcome. German language is NOT necessarily required. Tasks Tätigkeiten, Herausforderungen & Aufgaben während Ihres Praktikums: Migration eines bestehenden SHOPWARE 5.7x Webshops (E-Commerce) auf die jüngste Version der neuen SHOPWARE Architektur 6.x Verwendete Sprachen/Datenbanken: PHP, MySQL, XML, HTML, CSS, JS, Twig Dieses Praktikum gibt Ihnen einen vollständigen Einblick in einen modernen Webshop und die zugrunde liegende Software-Architektur und bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, auf allen Ebenen (Backend und/oder Frontend) kreativ tätig zu sein. Sie können sich an der Migration unseres SHOPWARE-Webshops beteiligen, eigene Module entwickeln und bestehende modifizieren. Nach einer Einarbeitungs-, Trainings- und Nachschulungsphase (wo nötig) können Sie selbst kreativ und eigenständig produktive Beiträge leisten: Entwicklung eigener Plugins bzw. Erweiterungen ("Extensions") sowie Modifizierung bzw. Übertragung vorhandener Extensions in funktionaler Anpassung an die heutige Shopware-6.x-Architektur Freie Entwicklung weiterer nützlicher zukünftiger Funktionalitäten (zusätzliche Features, unabhängige Plugins) Testen von Plugins, die auf dem Markt (Community) verfügbar sind Bei Interesse ist auch die Neugestaltung von Frontend-Themes (Frontend) möglich Optimierung von Anpassungen auf anderen Geräten (Reaktionsfähigkeit, Verbesserung der Skalierbarkeit) Modifizierung und/oder Neugestaltung von Frontend-Themes (bei Interesse an Webdesign) Konzeption von Schnittstellen zwischen interner Verlagssoftware und Webshop Optional besteht bei Bedarf Ihrerseits bei uns die Möglichkeit, ein Projekt bei uns als Ihre Studien/Ausbildungs-Facharbeit (z. B. Bachelorarbeit, Masterarbeit o. ä.) zu realisieren. Requirements ALLGEMEINE VORAUSSETZUNGEN Sie haben ein freundliches Auftreten und eine positive Lebenseinstellung, sind ehrlich, offen und kontaktfreudig Sie arbeiten eigenständig, sorgfältig, engagiert, selbstständig, überlegt und strukturiert und können Eigeninitiative entwickeln Sie sind in der Lage, sich in die Erfordernisse eines komplementärmedizinischen Verlags hineinzudenken und haben Lust, sich in diesem Bereich zu betätigen. SPEZIELLE VORAUSSETZUNGEN FÜR DIESES PRAKTIKUM: Einschlägiges Studium mit IT/ E-Commerce-Affinität, idealerweise eines IT-nahen Faches wie Informatik, Medieninformatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik und/oder Aus- oder eigene Weiterbildung als Webdesigner, Systembetreuer oder Programmierer. Solide Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in PHP, MySQL, JS, XML, HTML, CSS. Sie haben bereits komplexere Projekte absolviert, die PHP und JS beinhalten und können diese auch nachweisen (bitte über den Bewerben-Button einreichen). Sicherheit im Umgang mit MySQL Datenbanken Erfahrungen in der Frontend- und Backend-Webprogrammierung Grundkenntnisse in gängigen Ecommerce-Architekturen wie Shopware oder XT-Commerce wären zusätzlich von Vorteil, sind aber keine Vorbedingung. Benefits Sie können umfassend eigenständig tätig werden, mit großem gestalterischen und kreativen Freiraum. Und Sie lernen das Shopware-System auf allen Ebenen (Frontend, Backend, Developer) umfassend kennen. Sie bekommen Ihre eigenen Testserver als Übungs- und Entwicklungsfläche und können sich dort frei betätigen. Bei Abschluss des Praktikums erhalten Sie ein detailliertes, qualifiziertes Praktikumszeugnis, das sich als Sprungbrett in größere E-Commerce-Firmen bzw. IT-Agenturen erwiesen hat. Bei entsprechendem Einsatz können Sie durch das Praktikum zu einem Shopware-Experten werden, da Sie bei uns das gesamte Webshop-System kennenlernen und nicht nur einen kleinen Ausschnitt. Vergütung: Als kleiner Betrieb können wir in der Regel (insbesondere bei noch geringen Programmierkenntnissen) keine Praktikumsvergütung leisten. title: Werkstudent Gebäudeautomation (m/w/d)
description: Das sind wir: BuildlinX entwickelt die nächste Generation der Gebäudeautomation. Genau hier setzen wir an - und machen Gebäude grundlegend effizienter und klimafreundlicher. Mit einem Team von rund 20 Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir dafür die Technologie und die Werkzeuge, die Gebäudeautomation einfacher und skalierbarer machen. Hands-on vor Ort: Du unterstützt unsere Umsetzung in den Gebäuden, installierst Sensorik sowie weitere Hardware und grenzt Fehlerquellen an technischen Anlagen systematisch ein. Modellierung: Du modellierst Standorte als digitalen Zwilling und schaffst so die Datengrundlage für unsere Optimierungen. Datenanalyse: Mit unseren digitalen Tools untersuchst Du Standorte nach Fehlern oder Anomalien und arbeitest Ursachen heraus. Tech-Setup: Du provisionierst Edge-Computer, konfigurierst Hardware und unterstützt unser Team im operativen Projektgeschäft. Prozess-Gestaltung: Du arbeitest aktiv daran mit, unsere Projektabläufe noch effizienter zu machen und sie zu leben. Das bringst Du mit: Studium: Du studierst Energie-und Gebäudetechnik, Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Mechatronik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang (mind. noch 2 Semester). Planverständnis: Du kannst technische Pläne lesen und verstehen (z. B. Hydraulikschemata, Elektroschaltpläne, Lüftungs- oder Automationsschemata). Technik-Verständnis: Du verstehst komplexe technische Systeme in der Regelungs-, Steuerungs- und Kommunikationstechnik schnell und bringst eine Begeisterung für Software und IT mit. Mindset: Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und hast keine Angst davor, auch mal selbst zum Schraubendreher zu greifen. Auftreten: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und trittst unseren Kunden gegenüber professionell und freundlich auf. Pluspunkte (optional): Eine abgeschlossene handwerkliche Ausbildung (z. B. Elektriker, Mechatroniker). Erweiterte Kenntnisse in der Hands-On-Programmierung. Vorerfahrung im Bereich TGA (Technische Gebäudeausrüstung). Das sind Deine Vorteile bei uns: Eigenverantwortung: Kleines dynamisches Team, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege. Zentrale Lage & Arbeitsmodell: Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell. Unser zentral gelegenes Büro ist gut erreichbar und bietet Raum für Austausch und Zusammenarbeit. Steile Lernkurve: Du lernst hands-on, wie Projekte in einem modernen Start-up funktionieren, im direkten Austausch mit unserem CEO und dem Tech-Team. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>San Francisco, CA</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Finance team is a critical pillar of Cloudflare’s success, translating strategy into financial outcomes, and serving as a trusted voice to the public markets, the Board, and our shareholders. The Investor Relations team is a small, high-impact group that tells Cloudflare’s financial story to the public markets — translating one of the most differentiated technology platforms in the world into a clear, credible, and compelling investment narrative.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for an Associate, Investor Relations & Strategic Finance to join our lean IR team and help power how we engage with Wall Street. You will be a core contributor to the quarterly earnings cycle, our consensus and financial modeling work, investor events including our annual Investor Day, and strategic finance projects for senior leadership.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. The work you produce will go directly to the CFO, CEO, Board, and public markets, so we hold ourselves to an exceptionally high bar on accuracy. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, FP&A, and the executive team, and you will get broad exposure to the business and to the public markets. We are AI-native in how we work, and we expect you to treat modern tooling as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, and rigor.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Quarterly earnings and consensus</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the end-to-end quarterly earnings process, helping draft and assemble the press release, supplemental financial information, prepared remarks, Q&A prep, and investor deck.</li> <li>Build and maintain our consensus model: collect and analyze sell-side estimates and models, and benchmark them against internal forecasts.</li> <li>Support the title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines - 60%
description: À propos de FPP Industries FPP Industries poursuit son développement et souhaite aujourd’hui structurer davantage sa fonction Ressources Humaines. Dans ce contexte, nous créons un poste de Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines à 60 % , directement rattaché à la Direction générale. L’enjeu : construire une gestion RH à la fois fiable, structurée et humaine, capable d’accompagner durablement le développement de l’entreprise. Pourquoi ce poste existe Jusqu’à présent, les différents sujets RH ont été pris en charge sans fonction RH dédiée. Avec le développement de l’entreprise, nous souhaitons désormais franchir une nouvelle étape : fiabiliser l’administration du personnel, structurer nos pratiques RH et offrir aux collaborateurs comme aux managers un interlocuteur clairement identifié. Il s’agit donc d’une création de poste . Vous rejoindrez une fonction qui a déjà un cadre et des responsabilités définis, mais dans laquelle de nombreux processus restent à structurer et à faire évoluer. Votre mission Votre mission sera de structurer, administrer et faire vivre les Ressources Humaines de FPP Industries , en garantissant une gestion fiable du quotidien tout en construisant progressivement les pratiques RH dont l’entreprise aura besoin pour poursuivre son développement. Vous serez le référent RH opérationnel de l’entreprise et travaillerez en lien direct avec la Direction, les managers, les collaborateurs ainsi que les partenaires externes. Vos responsabilités principales Garantir une administration RH et une paie fiables. Vous prenez en charge le suivi administratif des collaborateurs, de leur arrivée à leur départ : contrats et avenants, absences, congés, périodes d’essai, visites médicales, échéances et dossiers individuels. Vous collectez et contrôlez les variables de paie, établissez les bulletins de salaire et sécurisez leur remise dans les délais. Piloter les recrutements et les intégrations. Vous accompagnez les managers dans la définition de leurs besoins, rédigez et diffusez les offres, présélectionnez les candidatures, réalisez les premiers entretiens et coordonnez le processus jusqu’à l’intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs. Développer les compétences. Vous identifiez les besoins avec les managers, organisez et suivez les formations et contribuez progressivement à construire une vision claire des compétences disponibles et à développer dans l’entreprise. Accompagner les managers et les collaborateurs. Vous devenez un interlocuteur RH accessible au quotidien. Vous accompagnez les managers dans leurs problématiques humaines, organisez les campagnes d’entretiens et contribuez à identifier suffisamment tôt les situations nécessitant une attention particulière. Structurer et améliorer les pratiques RH. Vous fiabilisez les données, construisez les indicateurs utiles au pilotage, formalisez les processus et proposez des améliorations concrètes pour simplifier le fonctionnement RH et l’expérience collaborateur. Accompagner la mise en conformité liée au développement de l’entreprise. Vous contribuerez notamment aux chantiers liés au CSE, au DUERP et à la structuration progressive de la démarche RSE, en lien avec la Direction et l’évolution de l’entreprise. Ce que nous attendons de vous Indispensable Vous disposez de bases solides en administration du personnel et droit social français . Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge la production des bulletins de salaire , tout en sachant solliciter un prestataire ou un conseil externe lorsqu’une situation nécessite une expertise technique ou réglementaire particulière. Vous savez conduire un recrutement, accompagner une intégration et travailler avec des managers sur leurs problématiques RH quotidiennes. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils bureautiques et suffisamment structuré(e) pour tenir des données, documents et échéances RH avec un haut niveau de fiabilité. La confidentialité, la rigueur et la fiabilité sont pour vous non négociables. Votre manière de travailler Ce poste conviendra particulièrement à une personne qui apprécie autant faire fonctionner le quotidien que construire ce qui n’existe pas encore . Vous aimez comprendre avant d’agir, structurer, documenter et améliorer. Vous êtes capable d’avancer de manière autonome dans votre périmètre tout en sachant identifier les décisions qui nécessitent un arbitrage de la Direction. Vous savez écouter sans perdre votre neutralité, accompagner sans vous substituer au manager et challenger avec tact lorsqu’une situation le nécessite. Vous êtes également à l’aise dans un environnement où la fonction RH continuera à évoluer avec le développement de l’entreprise. Ce que nous vous offrons Vous rejoignez FPP Industries au moment où la fonction RH se structure réellement. Vous ne reprendrez donc pas simplement un poste existant : vous aurez l’opportunité de contribuer directement à la construction et à l’amélioration de nos pratiques RH . Le poste offre un lien direct avec la Direction, une réelle autonomie dans l’organisation du quotidien RH et un périmètre susceptible d’évoluer progressivement avec le développement de l’entreprise et du groupe. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne souhaitant construire une fonction utile, pragmatique et proche du terrain. Les différentes étapes du processus et leurs délais vous seront présentés clairement dès les premiers échanges. Envie de construire cette fonction avec nous ? Si vous aimez les Ressources Humaines à la fois pour leur exigence administrative, leur dimension humaine et leur rôle dans la structuration d’une entreprise , nous serons heureux de découvrir votre candidature. description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France. Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals). You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers. At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method . This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft). title: Backend Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL in a system we built entirely ourselves. Full stack welcome. Berlin or nearby, hybrid. Full-time, permanent. Start: as soon as possible What this is about Careship helps families find reliable support in everyday life: all across Germany, through self-employed caregivers and our own employed caregivers. Behind both stands a platform we built entirely ourselves, live since August 2026: a Python backend, an internal staff portal, an app for customers and an app for caregivers. The system covers everything from the first inquiry to payroll: matching, scheduling, care budgets, billing with care insurance funds, payment processing and digital contracts, plus email, chat, WhatsApp and phone calls in one inbox. It is live, it runs the operations of two companies, and it grows every week. This is why we are looking for the second person in our permanent engineering duo. Your role You work as one of two engineers on our system, with a focus on the Python backend: data model, business logic, APIs and the integrations our operations run on. If full stack is your thing, the rest is open to you: the staff portal in Next.js and our two apps in React Native. You share responsibility and cover for each other, in everyday work and during vacations. You build features from the data model through the business logic to the finished API endpoint, and all the way to the screen if you want. You work on core topics like the budget engine, billing, the payroll pipeline and matching. Logic where diligence really counts. You maintain code in production that real people use every day: our operations team, caregivers, and customers with their families. You work directly with product and the tech lead, no layers in between. Requirements arrive as fully worked-out specifications from our knowledge base, not as two-line tickets. You get freedom and real responsibility: the system is brand new, much of it is taking shape right now, and you help decide where it goes. The roadmap includes shift planning, analytics, a marketing module and an ambassador platform. Our stack Backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, PostgreSQL, on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) Portal: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, MUI, TanStack Query, generated OpenAPI client Apps: React Native with Expo, shipped through the app stores Integrations: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Meet), Auth0, Aircall, WhatsApp and DATEV, plus payment and e-signature providers How we work: AI-assisted. Specifications, code and reviews are created with AI support, as our everyday standard, not as an experiment. What you bring At least 3 years of experience in professional product development, more is a plus Solid Python experience in production, ideally with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy or comparable frameworks Confidence with relational databases and SQL, PostgreSQL in our case You already code with AI support as a matter of course, ideally with real enthusiasm. For us this is a requirement, because it is how we work every day. Diligence where mistakes cost money or trust: billing, payments, personal data Fluent English. German is a plus. Appetite for a small team with a lot of responsibility and a direct line to the people who use your software Nice to have TypeScript, React, React Native or Next.js, if you also want to work on the frontend App store releases and Expo EAS Google Cloud, Google Workspace APIs, or experience with payment and e-signature integrations Experience in regulated domains such as health, care or fintech WebSockets and real-time features German language skills, since our domain and our specifications are in German What we offer A brand-new system with real room to shape it: two engineers, clear specifications, no decades-old legacy, and plenty of space to keep building Freedom and responsibility from day one, flat hierarchies, no meeting marathons Real social impact: your work helps seniors get support and makes sure caregivers are paid fairly and on time Home office with regular shared days at our Berlin office Several weeks per year of fully remote work, from abroad if you like 30 days of paid vacation A new MacBook with serious power An annual learning budget plus two extra paid learning days An Urban Sports membership Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) Regular team events What happens next Our process is deliberately fast and straightforward, in three steps: a short intro call, a technical interview, and finally a small case study plus meet the team.
