title: Talent Acquisition Manager, Talent Acquisition
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>As Vinted continues to scale and expand its product offerings, acquiring the right talent remains core to our growth, and our Talent Acquisition team is a key driver behind it. Proactive sourcing, designing fair assessment processes, delivering a seamless candidate experience, consulting business stakeholders on hiring decisions, and constant refinement to ensure quality and efficiency is our bread and butter. </p> <p>As a Talent Acquisition Manager, you will join our TA Leadership Team to shape and execute a forward-looking talent acquisition strategy aligned with Vinted’s business ambitions. In this role, you will build and empower a high-performing TA team, cultivating a healthy, collaborative environment grounded in our Leadership Way and core values. Serving as a strategic partner to senior business leaders and the broader People function, you will translate market intelligence and TA analytics into actionable hiring plans, lead high-impact recruitment initiatives, and drive continuous operational excellence.</p> <p>If you are an experienced TA leader passionate about developing people, optimising hiring processes, and scaling impactful talent acquisition initiatives, we would love to meet you.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build, lead, and develop a team of TA Specialists, ensuring excellent performance, fostering growth, continuous learning, and a collaborative environment.</li> <li>As part of the Talent Acquisition leadership team, co-create and drive the implementation of TA strategy and roadmap.</li> <li>Partner with senior business leaders and hiring managers to co-create and implement effective functional TA strategy in line with business context. </li> <li>Oversee end-to-end recruitment execution, ensuring quality assessments, efficient processes, and high standards across candidate experience.</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on market trends, salary benchmarking, candidate pipelines, and resource allocation.</li> <li>Track, analyze, and report on key TA metrics to continuously optimise recruitment performance, improve process efficiency and quality of hire.</li> <li>Own and contribute to cross-functional TA projects, such as interviewer training, employer branding, hiring framework improvements, and recruiter enablement tools.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Demonstrated track record as a Talent Acquisition Manager or TA Team Lead, managing performance, development, and growth.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of modern sourcing strategies, candidate evaluation techniques, and competitive talent markets across Tech functions.</li> <li>Experience using recruitment analytics to evaluate efficiency, identify bottlenecks, and inform decisions for improvement.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify root causes, and implement pragmatic, effective solutions.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence, guide, and collaborate with senior business stakeholders, hiring managers, and People team colleagues. </li> <li>Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (English is Vinted’s official working language).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€78.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€105.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h1>Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI</h1> <p>Every day, thousands of shipments cross borders, change hands, and hit unexpected problems. For decades, fixing those problems meant phone calls, emails, and humans heroically firefighting. We think that's about to change completely.</p> <p>We've been building AI agents that spot trouble before it happens, reroute shipments, and keep goods moving—with our team of experts in the loop where it counts. The early results have been jaw-dropping. We're now going all in on a future where supply chains run themselves, and we're looking for the people who want to build that future with us.</p> <p>This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. You'll find the highest-leverage problems, design the solutions, and ship them to operators moving freight across 112 countries. If that sounds like your idea of a good time, read on.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <p>You'll build the cutting-edge agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations smarter, faster, and increasingly autonomous. Your agents will have immediate, measurable impact</li> <li><strong>Full ownership</strong>: from problem definition to production deployment, it's yours</li> <li><strong>You're early</strong>: the playbook for applied AI in enterprise logistics doesn't exist yet—you'll help write it</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What's in it for you: </strong></h2> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment </li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis </li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam</li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. title: Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car</a>, a <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/579-fossils">Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton</a>, <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/l/10035805">Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit</a> or <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Usain Bolt’s running shoe</a>, we encounter exceptional objects every day.</p> <p>We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.</p> <p>Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.</p> <ul> <li>Taking ownership and driving impact </li> <li>Being open to change and feedback</li> <li>Being passionate about our mission and our customers. </li> </ul></div><h3>Your mission</h3> <p>As Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning, you’ll lead Catawiki’s established team of Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists. You’ll help the team grow, set its technical direction and build on work already underway across data foundations and production machine learning.</p> <p>The role spans two connected disciplines. You’ll bring deep experience in either Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, and enough breadth to set direction across the other.</p> <p>You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to set priorities and connect the team’s work to outcomes across Catawiki.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>You’ll lead the team through platform modernisation and product-facing ML work. Current priorities include modernising the infrastructure for serving production models, introducing a feature store to improve feature management and consistency across model training and serving, and strengthening observability and cost controls. You’ll help set priorities and raise the reliability and impact of this work.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and develop the team:</strong> Set direction, coach experienced specialists and create clear ownership across Data Engineering and Machine Learning.</li> <li><strong>Build dependable data foundations:</strong> Improve the pipelines, integrations and infrastructure the wider Data team relies on for analysis, reporting and machine learning.</li> <li><strong>Strengthen production ML:</strong> Improve deployment, monitoring and operational follow-through for production models, so teams can run them reliably and resolve issues effectively.</li> <li><strong>Advance marketplace models:</strong> Help teams improve recommendation, cancellation and bidder-risk use cases, connecting model performance to meaningful product outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Set direction and priorities:</strong> Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business partners to choose high-value problems and balance delivery, reliability and long-term platform health.</li> <li><strong>Shape the technology strategy:</strong> Reporting to the SVP Engineering, you’ll join the Engineering Management team and help shape the direction of the Technology department.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <p>You combine strong technical judgement with experienced people leadership. You create clarity in a complex environment, empower specialists and make sound decisions across both disciplines.</p> <p>Your experience will include the following. Familiarity with Catawiki’s current stack is useful, and equivalent experience with other platforms is welcome.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical depth in one discipline:</strong> Deep experience designing, building and operating data-intensive systems in Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, with practical knowledge of the other.</li> <li><strong>People leadership:</strong> Experience leading experienced engineers or ML specialists, coaching their growth and setting clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Architecture and systems thinking:</strong> Ability to evaluate trade-offs and guide architecture for data platforms, distributed systems and production infrastructure.</li> <li><strong>Production ML understanding:</strong> Experience with the deployment, monitoring and operation of machine learning systems in production.</li> <li><strong>Business and product judgement:</strong> Ability to connect technical work to business goals, make priority calls and assess outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Relevant cloud platform experience:</strong> We run on GCP using BigQuery, Vertex AI and Kubernetes. Experience with equivalent AWS services is also relevant.</li> <li><strong>Streaming and integration experience:</strong> Kafka, event-driven systems or modern data integration tools are useful.</li> <li><strong>Clear communication:</strong> Ability to explain technical trade-offs and align technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How we work</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ll lead a team of eight Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists across Amsterdam and Lisbon.</li> <li>The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to connect data and ML capabilities to real needs.</li> <li>Specialists own implementation while you set direction, priorities and clear standards.</li> <li>The team supports production data and ML systems, and has no on-call rotation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Where you'll be</strong></h3> <p>This is a <em>hybrid</em> role in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="text text-align-left "> <h3><strong>Why You'll Love Working with Us</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Create a visible impact </strong>by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.</li> <li><strong>Learn and grow</strong> through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.</li> <li><strong>A culture of connection defines us</strong>. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.</li> <li><strong>Celebrate life’s moments with us. </strong>You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion<strong>”</strong>. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Offices and Way of Working</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.</p> </div> <h3><strong>Interested?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/conditions/applicant-privacy-policy.pdf">Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy.</a> If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.<br><br>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Real-World Data Associate
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: Real-World Data Associate As a Real-World Data Associate at myTomorrows, you will support the design and execution of real-world data collection within Expanded Access Programs and other non-interventional studies. Working closely with the Real-World Data team, you will help keep communication with clients, physicians and site staff running smoothly, carry out data validation and quality-control tasks, and contribute to the documentation that supports consistent, high-quality RWD delivery. This is a great opportunity to build hands-on experience in real-world data within a purpose-driven, fast-growing company. Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance to our office in Amsterdam. What you’ll do in this role: Support the design and day-to-day execution of RWD collection within Expanded Access Programs and other non-interventional studies. Assist in maintaining communication with clients, physicians and site staff about data collection and data management. Help monitor RWD collection and completion, flagging data discrepancies or missing data for follow-up. Perform basic data validation, cleaning and quality-control tasks in electronic data capture systems. Follow relevant regulatory requirements, internal procedures and ICH-GCP principles in all RWD study activities. Support the preparation and maintenance of SOPs, templates and study documentation for RWD projects. Share observations and ideas that could improve data collection, workflows and supporting tools. Work under the guidance of more senior team members, collaborating closely with colleagues across the team and other relevant functions. What you bring to the table: A bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, biomedical sciences or another relevant scientific field. 0–2 years of experience in Data Management or Clinical Research (e.g. an internship, traineeship or first role). Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage priorities and follow through on commitments. Familiarity with, or a strong interest in learning, electronic data capture systems and structured clinical or real-world data. A basic understanding of ICH-GCP guidelines, or the motivation to develop it quickly. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Close attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. Eagerness to learn and the ability to contribute positively to a collaborative team environment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. What Success looks like in the first 6 months: Data completion and quality metrics for your assigned programs are consistently on target. You’re contributing ideas and improvements to RWD processes and documentation, helping to raise the bar for data excellence at myTomorrows. You’re recognized as a reliable partner by both internal teams and external collaborators, someone who ensures the integrity of real-world data to advance patient access What we offer: Serve a purposeful mission: helping patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organization. Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and equity. Great career-development opportunities in a growing company. Learning and development budget, alongside internal knowledge-sharing sessions. Attractive pension plan, with the full premium covered by us. Hybrid work model (2 days in office). title: Production Engineer
description: Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour. We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week. You might enjoy Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage , or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like . About the role Monumental are already deploying robots into the real world at scale, building beautiful, bespoke homes. Our robots are on sites across the Netherlands and the UK and will be in the US within a year. Every deployment teaches us something about our hardware; you’ll push our R&D fleet to become one ready for large-series production: you'll own taking us from tens of robots a year to hundreds, and then thousands. You'll also keep that growing fleet deployable, and making design changes yourself to improve reliability and serviceability. Scaling a fleet means solving whatever is in the way: limited space, no clear production process, lead times we can't live with and modules that don't survive the harsh conditions of a construction site. You’ll be expected to wear many hats; we’re looking for people who are genuinely excited to lead these efforts. Our robots are built from modules at every level of maturity, so expect to work with the hardware R&D team at early stages of development to validate R&D designs as fast as we can. In parallel, you'll be in the workshop determining how we assemble them: the processes, the fixtures, the production space itself, getting the very best out of our Amsterdam facilities. For more context on building hardware at Monumental, read Niall’s Substack: I quit my job and moved country to make robots that will fix Europe’s housing crisis. What you'll do Bottom line, you'll own increasing our quarterly production from 30 sets of robot systems to 100 within a year. This is a challenge. You'll be building the production capabilities at Monumental rather than inheriting them, and you'll do it alongside engineers and technicians who care a great deal about getting this right. Take prototypes through to production-ready modules. Find and address design flaws, validate improvements, and push these modules to production. Assembling modules, understand the friction slowing production, and address issues yourself along with the hardware team. Develop fixtures, jigs and light automation solutions to support module assembly. Find production processes that bring minimal value when done in-house. Work with external suppliers to outsource them, while maintaining production quality. Produce drawings, assembly instructions and quality checks to make sure our modules are integrated together and our robots are brought up with no errors. Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. Stakeholder management across functions and geographies — aligning engineering, applied science, business teams, and executive leadership around a shared roadmap. Comfort with ambiguity: you structure complex problems, propose pilots to validate direction, and create clarity for new and evolving teams. title: Total Rewards & People Business Partner
description: People Business Partner & Total Rewards Most People roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, and to own one of them outright: how Eye rewards and recognises its people. You’ll do that while partnering the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn’t it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading. The role This role has two halves, and you’ll split your time roughly evenly between them. The first half is Total Rewards. You’ll own compensation and benefits at Eye, including salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling, benefits and our equity program. There’s no finished framework waiting for you. You’ll shape it, make it hold up as we grow, and get us ready for EU pay transparency. You don’t need to be a reward specialist yet. If you owned reward projects before and want to make this your expertise, this is where you do it. The second half is partnering. You’ll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & onboarding, and project management. It’s the most varied population in the company: working students running shift rosters next to deeply specialized senior engineers, and managers at very different stages of their leadership journey. That mix is exactly why this role needs presence more than years. You’ll coach a first-time manager on the basics one hour and align a salary band with C-level the next. You’ll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it. What you’ll do Own Total Rewards end to end: run the annual salary review, keep our benchmarks honest, and build levelling and salary bands that make sense to managers and employees alike. Manage benefits: run our benefits across the Netherlands, the UK, Germany and Belgium, work with providers, and keep improving what actually matters to our people. Manage our equity program: grants, refreshers, and making sure people understand what their equity means. Prepare Eye for pay transparency: work with Legal and Finance so we’re ready for the EU directive, not scrambling to catch up. Be the trusted partner for leaders in security operations and customer support: coaching, challenging and advising at every level of maturity, up to and including the executive team. Be visible. This is an office where face-to-face matters: you’ll be on the floor in The Hague, listening to what’s actually going on, not partnering from a distance. Handle the real side of employee relations: sick leave and reintegration, conduct issues and complex cases, working with external counsel when needed. You’ve seen the challenging cases and you don’t flinch. Work as part of a small, tight People team: everyone picks things up, and so will you. What we’re looking for HRBP experience in a scaling tech environment. You know what good looks like at 200+ people. Hands-on reward experience. Around a year in a reward or C&B role, or several reward projects you led yourself: salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling or benefits. Specialist depth is not required; curiosity to build it is. Comfortable with numbers. You can build a comp analysis in a spreadsheet and explain it to a manager who has never seen one. Strong stakeholder management and the presence to challenge back, including senior leadership, without becoming the policy police. Genuinely comfortable with ambiguity. Our problems don’t come with a manual, and you’d rather solve them creatively than wait for one. Hands-on, working knowledge of Dutch labor law, and you know when to bring in an expert. Professional English. Dutch is a plus, not a requirement. Based in the Netherlands and happy coming into the office: at least 1 day a week in The Hague, ideally 3. What we offer Real impact: help build the People foundations of a company protecting businesses across Europe, alongside colleagues from intelligence, military, tech and consulting backgrounds. A clear path to make Total Rewards your specialism, with direct exposure to the leadership team. Thursday borrels and regular team socials to catch up in person. Quarterly get-togethers and an annual company-wide retreat (Spain, Portugal, Italy…). Generous time off, including wellbeing days, floating holidays and a volunteering day. Competitive base salary and company equity. MacBook Pro or Dell XPS, plus iPhone or Samsung. About Eye Security Eye Security protects European mid-market businesses from cyber threats: 24/7 monitoring and response, incident response, and integrated cyber insurance, all in one. We’re 170+ people across the Netherlands, UK, Germany and Belgium, with roots in Dutch intelligence and national CERTs. Our mission is simple: enterprise-grade security shouldn’t only be for enterprises Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.</p> <ul> <li>Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a<strong> Silicon Alliance partner manager in Beijing or Shanghai</strong> to drive Canonical’s joint initiatives and technical engagements with major semiconductor partners.   The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge. </p> <p>The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. complex material and synthesize key points.</li> <li>Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels.</li> <li>Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with open source software and open source business models.</li> <li>Team leadership or program management experience.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Understanding of marketing and go-to-market strategy</li> <li>Experience working with Chinese based tech companies.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider title: Senior Product Manager, Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:  </strong></p> <p>Planet is expanding its platform capabilities to support customers who require dedicated, in-region, or on-premises instantiations of our core platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments, you will drive the productization of our platform for isolated, air-gapped, and hybrid environments.</p> <p>You will serve as the critical bridge between high-touch enterprise customer delivery and scalable core engineering. In this role, you will balance deep customer empathy with product discipline—translating complex operational requirements into repeatable core platform capabilities while establishing clear extension points for Professional Services.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct deep-dive discovery with high-security enterprise and government stakeholders to understand their operational realities, using those insights to set clear, defensible product priorities.</li> <li>Define and structure the explicit, phased customer journey framework—establishing the operational models, readiness criteria, and governance standards for initial platform installation, joint-operations training, and the final transition into fully autonomous, customer-operated environments with zero or limited vendor access.</li> <li>Translate customer operational and security requirements into clear technical specifications for Core Infrastructure and Engineering teams with detail-oriented accuracy. Synthesizes underlying commonalities across clients who describe similar operational needs using different language, preventing costly, redundant engineering effort.</li> <li>Define standardized building blocks that allow the core platform to extend safely into varying edge and air-gapped environments without hardcoding custom variants for every deployment.</li> <li>Define clear boundaries for what belongs in the core platform versus what can be customized. Design clear hooks and interfaces so Professional Services and integration partners can build custom extensions without modifying core platform code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of relevant work experience in Technical Product Management focusing on enterprise platforms, hybrid cloud deployments, or complex infrastructure products.</li> <li>Ability to sit down with enterprise or government clients, listen to complex operational workflows, and identify the root problem behind divergent customer terminology.</li> <li>Track record productizing cloud-native software platforms to deploy into customer-managed infrastructure, enterprise VPCs, or air-gapped data centers.</li> <li>Ability to apply conceptual understanding of enterprise hybrid patterns similar to AWS Outposts, Azure Stack, Kubernetes-based enterprise distribution platforms (e.g., Red Hat OpenShift), or infrastructure automation frameworks (e.g., HashiCorp Terraform/Vault).</li> <li>Experience setting clear boundaries between core platform roadmap items and custom extensions delivered by Professional Services.</li> <li>Detail-oriented mindset capable of mapping out complex operational transitions, training milestones, and access handoffs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience navigating European sovereign cloud frameworks, regional data residency mandates, or EU defense/government compliance standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off </li> <li>Employee Wellness Program </li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity </li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.<br><br><strong>Kimchi Inference</strong></p> <p>One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.<br><br></p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.</p> <p>Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.</li> <li>Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.</li> <li>You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.</li> <li>You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine<br> fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or<br> network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the<br> unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.</li> <li>Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business<br> taking an hour to reach serving.</li> <li>Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.</li> <li>Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck<br> on storage or interconnect.</li> <li>Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible<br> experiments.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li>Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. </li> <li>Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li>Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.</li> <li>Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li>Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li>Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical interview (system design)</li> <li>Live coding</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive</li> </ul> <p><em>As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>Please note that Cast AI </em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router)
description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and the router deciding which model answers each request is ours too.<br><br><strong>The Auto Router</strong></p> <p>Our promise is one enforcement layer for your AI: budgets, spend attribution, and model routing, applied before a request ever hits a model. The Auto Router makes the call: for every request, which model serves it. Eight open-source models whose input prices span more than 20×, cached input up to 50× cheaper than fresh, frontier providers on customers' own keys, and a coding agent that fires hundreds of requests before its task is done. Frontier-level task success at a fraction of the token cost: that sentence is the product, and it stays true only if the model inside the router keeps getting better. That model is yours.</p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made </span></em><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Every request gets a decision: which model serves it.</p> <p>This is an applied-ML seat, not an infrastructure one. Platform engineers own the proxy, the streaming path, and the fleet. You own the model inside them: the training data, the objective, the evaluation, and the iteration loop that ships a better router every cycle.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> routing is a prediction problem wearing a product's clothes. For every request you predict the quality each candidate model would deliver, what it would cost, and how fast it would decode, and you have to be right enough, in aggregate, that the savings are real and the quality never dips below frontier. The data is messy: rollout outcomes from benchmark harnesses, per-request records from the live fleet, override signals, and token streams whose speed depends on the serving concurrency at the moment. Speed itself is a correctness variable: on deadline-bound agentic work, a model that decodes three times slower doesn't do the same work slower, it does less work. That's why naive cost-per-token objectives quietly optimize for the wrong thing. And the bar for evidence is high: a router change ships only after production-parity evaluation with error bars, then gets held to its numbers in live traffic.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; PyTorch; SQL at scale (ClickHouse); OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM APIs; benchmark and rollout harnesses (RouterBench-class); GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've spent 5+ years in applied ML or ML research, and you've trained, evaluated, and shipped models that make real-time decisions (ranking, recommendation, bandits, pricing, or LLM routing) and you can tell that story with receipts.</li> <li>Strong Python and SQL at scale: you can pull, clean, and interrogate millions of request-level records without waiting on anyone.</li> <li>You know the difference between a model that got better and an eval that got easier.</li> <li>You have real opinions about what LLM benchmarks measure, agentic harnesses included.</li> <li>You know enough serving reality (TTFT, decode speed, batching, prefix caching, concurrency) to model the objective honestly.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, error bars and all.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Own the routing model end to end: features, objective, training, calibration, and release cadence. Iterate it like a product, not a research artifact.</li> <li>Build the evaluation that gates every change: production-parity benchmarks, router-vs-router comparisons, holdouts by task family, error bars on pass rates.<br> Nothing ships on vibes.</li> <li>Turn fleet data into training signal: per-request outcomes from production, benchmark rollouts, and override feedback, with failure categorization (infra vs<br> task) so poisoned labels never reach the policy.</li> <li>Model the objective the user actually experiences: task success × token cost × wall-clock speed under the real concurrency regime, with cached-input<br> economics in the picture.</li> <li>Run the online loop: shadow, A/B, full rollout, drift monitoring, retrain. When production disagrees with your offline eval, you find out why before the next<br> ship.</li> <li>Push the frontier where it pays: calibrated decisions, abstention under uncertainty, speed-aware routing. We experiment on what a router should be, not just<br> which model it picks today.</li> <li>Partner with platform engineers on instrumentation: the features and labels recorded per request (decode speed first-class among them) and the experiments<br> the data path must support.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li>Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. </li> <li>Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li>Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.</li> <li>Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li>Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li>Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical interview (system design)</li> <li>Live coding</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive</li> </ul> <p><em>As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>Please note that Cast AI </em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. Your role will be responsible for managing our MSSP partners, while cultivating long-term relationships with partners, and the SentinelOne field and Product/Engineering teams.</span></p> <h3>What will you do?</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Work with the Managed partner team to identify and qualify partnership opportunities, identify key partner technical objections, SentinelOne's solution</li> <li>Drive follow-ups with partner resources to consistently deliver on messaging how SentinelOne adds value to the partner and their customers.</li> <li>Plan and create go-to-market initiatives and offerings with SentinelOne partners</li> <li>Develop and execute technical training plans for partners.</li> <li>Own the technical relationship with SentinelOne's partners, and the coordination of additional technical resources.</li> <li>Deliver demonstrations and work hands-on with partners to demonstrate SentinelOne's value in the partner's environment or solutions.</li> </ul> <h3>What skills and knowledge should you bring?</h3> <p>Ideal candidates will have:</p> <ul> <li class="li1">10 Years+ in field, 5+ years Sales Engineering experience</li> <li class="li1">Exceptional track record of growing managed partner technical resources</li> <li class="li1">Strong background in building relationships with internal sales and product teams</li> <li class="li1">Experience presenting and delivering technical demos and sales values presentations to varying audiences from architects to C-level executives.</li> <li class="li1">Technical experience/skills for the successful candidate:</li> <li class="li1">Experience working with CSPs, channel, MSP/MSSPs, GSIs, or alliances partners.</li> <li class="li1">Ability to quickly learn, adapt, understand, and work with new emerging technologies, methodologies and solutions </li> <li class="li1">Fluent Dutch and English</li> <li class="li1">Willingness to travel up to 50%</li> </ul> If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity & Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off & Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance & Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Insurance and medical allowance</li> <li>Pension scheme</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks & Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Commuter or work-from-home allowance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellness & Lifestyle</strong></p> <ul> <li>Wellness benefit</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. title: Senior Employer Branding Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>Our team’s mission is to align Vinted’s values, business goals, and Employer Value Proposition with our people’s real work experience. We translate Vinted’s truth into an inspiring story that attracts the right people, helps them grow, and instils them with pride.</p> <p>You’ll take an active role in Employer Branding at Vinted, with a particular focus on attracting engineering and data science talent. You’ll be based in Amsterdam, where our data science team is growing, but your work will reach candidates around the world.</p> <p>Vinted has become an ecosystem with vertically integrated shipping and payments. This requires us to adapt our EVP to three very distinct brands and even more diversified hiring needs. Your job is to turn that into creative campaigns and stories that make specific audiences want to work here.</p> <p>Our next big focus is storytelling. Bringing the skills and challenges our teams face to life! What is a day in the life of a cybersecurity analyst? How does an anti-money laundering expert keep members’ wallets safe? What does it take to build the data science behind a marketplace used by millions? And what stories does each of our locations need?</p> <p>Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering and data science leaders, People, Marketing, PR, Internal Comms, and Brand & Design, you’ll make sure those stories are told and that our presence is strong where we hire.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Be the guardian of Vinted’s employer brand, ensuring consistency and visibility across all platforms, like LinkedIn and Instagram</li> <li>Strong brand-building skills, with a clear vision of global vs local branding differentiation</li> <li>Use your sound understanding of branding and our editorial guidelines to write clear and engaging copy for things such as blogs, advertising campaigns, employer branding assets, email campaigns, event materials, online company profiles, as well as our careers pages.</li> <li>Create bespoke or support partnership events such as meetups, webinars, and networking events</li> <li>Plan and run recruitment advertising, such as targeted LinkedIn campaigns and sponsorships with third-party publications and organisations, aimed at technical audiences.</li> <li>Define where our global employer brand ends and local adaptation begins, so each location can tell its story while staying consistent with Vinted’s.</li> <li>Shape our content calendar around hiring needs and our location strategy.</li> <li>Track what works, using results to sharpen the next activation, and share learnings with the wider Employer Branding team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Passionate about all things Employer Branding!</li> <li>You love storytelling: finding stories and having a keen eye for telling them in ways that stand out. You can show campaigns or activations you conceived and delivered.</li> <li>Background in building and nurturing online and offline communities, and delivering innovative events and social media campaigns.</li> <li>A clear view of global vs local branding, and experience working across markets.</li> <li>Adept at identifying new talent attraction channels, especially for engineering and data science audiences.</li> <li>Comfortable using data to set goals and judge what worked.</li> <li>Ability to juggle multiple projects with strong stakeholder management, and to work confidently with engineering and data science leaders.</li> <li>Excited by change, a fast pace, and learning new ways of doing things.</li> <li>Excellent knowledge of social media and digital channels, including LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, and Meta.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (English is Vinted’s official working language).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€59.800</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€81.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: B2B Growth Marketer - Benelux
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in the Benelux Region. This is a hands-on, in-region role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI. As our first marketing hire in the Benelux Region, your work will shape how Benelux businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise. What you'll do Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Benelux priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement. Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function. Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the the Benelux market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team. Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns. Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works. Requirements 4+ years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle. Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI. Deep knowledge of the Benelux market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network. Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market. Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Benefits Analyst on GitLab's Total Rewards team, you'll support global benefits administration and take ownership of day-to-day benefits operations in India, partnering closely with a Senior Benefits Analyst. Your initial priorities will include planning benefits events at the Bangalore hub, streamlining enrollment and benefits onboarding , handling tier 1 benefit questions and escalations, taking over and improving administrative and audit processes, along with routine benefits tasks.You'll build depth in global benefits and manage assigned work with increasing independence, seeking guidance on prioritization, new assignments, and higher-risk issues. This role reports to the Manager, Global Benefits and focuses on benefits programs, not leave administration. You'll need to be based in Bangalore, with periodic office presence for hosting and managing benefits events, and flexibility to collaborate across time zones, including Pacific time.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Support day-to-day administration for assigned benefits programs, including eligibility, enrollment, benefits onboarding, billing, reporting, audits, quality assurance, documentation, and issue resolution, with a particular focus on India.</li> <li>Review benefits and team-member data from multiple sources, research discrepancies and root causes, and recommend next steps for manager or senior team-member review.</li> <li>Work with brokers and vendors on day-to-day benefits operations, and support the Senior Benefits Analyst with renewals, plan changes, implementations, testing, launches, and post-launch improvements. Apply documented processes and escalate questions that require deeper local or technical expertise.</li> <li>Partner with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, and People Technology on accurate reporting, billing reconciliation, eligibility data, and compliance-related processes.</li> <li>Support People Operations in resolving team-member benefits inquiries, explain moderately complex benefits topics in accessible language, and escalate cases appropriately.</li> <li>Analyze benefits utilization, cost, survey, and qualitative data to identify trends and prepare summaries, insights, and recommendations that support team priorities.</li> <li>Maintain accurate documentation, process guides, trackers, and communications; support the transition of administrative processes and recommend ways to simplify, standardize, or automate them, including responsible use of artificial intelligence tools. failure domains, to Gitaly's storage and replication model.</li> <li>Own elastic storage and compute strategy for Git repository data, including capacity planning, autoscaling, and consumption-based assurance validation, and rollback.</li> <li value="7">Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.</li> <li value="8">Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.</li> <li value="3">Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.</li> <li value="4">Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="5">Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back.</li> <li value="6">A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains.</li> <li value="7">Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and decisions asynchronously so team members can build on them across time zones.</li> <li value="5">Review schema migrations from engineers across GitLab for safety, backward compatibility, and reliability.</li> <li value="6">Collaborate with Distribution, Quality Assurance, Database Architecture, Database Automation, and database framework teams to support GitLab.com and self-managed supply-chain problem.</li> <li><strong>Own What You Build in Production:</strong> Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during complex incidents, and turn what you learn into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence.</li> <li><strong>Influence and Partner:</strong> Shape technical direction across teams without formal authority, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform-level roadmap decisions and investment trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>Grow Engineers:</strong> Mentor
